words.ex: Smoking can imperil your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会危及你的健康。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk of being harmed, damaged, or destroyed.

words.ex: The two roads diverge after the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在桥后分岔。
words.en: If one thing diverges from another similar thing, the first thing becomes different from the second or develops differently from it. You can also say that two things diverge.

words.ex: His refusal to listen is irrational.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝倾听是不合理的。
words.en: If you describe someone's feelings and behavior as irrational, you mean they are not based on logical reasons or clear thinking.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.ex: The wound was cleaned with saline water.
words.ex_cn: 伤口用盐水清洗。
words.en: Saline is used to describe something that contains salt or is related to salt.

words.ex: The accident disabled him for life.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故使他终身残废。
words.en: If an injury or illness disables someone, it affects them so badly that it restricts the way that they can live their life.

words.ex: He tried to seduce her with flowers and gifts.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用鲜花和礼物引诱她。
words.en: To seduce someone means to persuade them to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by making it seem attractive or exciting.

words.ex: They decided to relocate to a quieter town.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定搬到一个更安静的城镇。
words.en: to move to a new place and establish one's home or business there

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；法律认可的；合理的；
words.ex: This contract is legitimate and signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同是合法的，并由双方签署。
words.en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

words.tr: adj. 需要久坐的；惯于久坐不动的；不爱活动的；
words.ex: His sedentary job makes him sit all day.
words.ex_cn: 他的久坐工作让他整天坐着。
words.en: Someone who has a sedentary lifestyle or job sits down a lot of the time and does not take much exercise.

words.tr: adj. 水上的；水运的；由水传播的
words.ex: The boat moved smoothly on the water-borne current.
words.ex_cn: 船在水上的水流中平稳前行。
words.en: Spread by or existing in water, especially as a means of transmission for diseases.

words.ex: The molten lava flowed down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 熔化的岩浆从山上流下。
words.en: Molten is used to describe substances that have been heated to a very high temperature and have turned into a liquid.

words.ex: The computer has a fast processor.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有一个快速的处理器。
words.en: A processor is a part of a computer that interprets and carries out instructions.

words.tr: v. 使浸透；使湿透；使满；使饱和
words.ex: The sponge will saturate if you pour too much water.
words.ex_cn: 如果你倒太多水，海绵会吸满。
words.en: To saturate something means to make it completely wet, or to fill it completely with something so that no more can be added.

words.tr: v. 使显得琐碎（或不重要、不难等）
words.ex: He trivializes serious problems by laughing at them.
words.ex_cn: 他通过嘲笑严重的问题来轻视它们。
words.en: If you say that someone trivializes something important, you disapprove of them because they make it seem less important, serious, or complex than it is.

words.ex: The obscene behavior shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这种可憎的行为让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: If you describe something as obscene, you mean it offends you because it relates to sex or violence in a way that you think is unpleasant and shocking.

words.tr: adj. 真正的；真实的；真迹的；可靠的；
words.ex: This is an authentic painting by Picasso.
words.ex_cn: 这是一幅毕加索的真迹。
words.en: If something is authentic, it is real, true, or what people say it is.

words.tr: adj. 公正的；正当的；正义的
words.ex: He is a righteous man who helps the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个帮助穷人的正直的人。
words.en: If you think that someone behaves or lives in a way that is morally good, you can say that they are righteous.

words.ex: The machine purifies water by removing dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器通过去除杂质来净化水。
words.en: To purify something means to make it clean and pure by removing dirty or harmful substances from it.

words.ex: Dolphins are gregarious animals that swim in groups.
words.ex_cn: 海豚是群居动物，成群游泳。
words.en: Someone who is gregarious enjoys being with other people.

words.ex: He gave a heartless reply to her plea.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的恳求给出了无情的答复。
words.en: If you describe someone as heartless, you mean that they are cruel and unkind, and have no sympathy for anyone or anything.

words.tr: v. 逐步渗透；逐渐灌输
words.ex: Parents try to instill good habits in their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母试图在孩子身上培养良好的习惯。
words.en: To instill something in someone means to gradually but firmly establish an idea or attitude in their mind.

words.ex: He infringes the rules by arriving late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而违反了规则。
words.en: To infringe means to violate or break a law, agreement, or right.

words.tr:
n. 连环漫画；
adj. 滑稽的；
words.ex: He reads a comic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本连环漫画。
words.en: A comic is someone who entertains people by making them laugh, especially a professional comedian.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.tr:
n. 鞭策；
v. 刺激；
words.ex: The competition served as a spur to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 竞争成了推动他更努力工作的鞭策。
words.en: A spur is something that makes you want to do something or that encourages you to do it. It can also refer to a sharp device worn on the heel of a rider's boot to urge a horse forward.

words.ex: The barbaric act shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个野蛮的行为震惊了所有人。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as barbaric, you mean that it is extremely cruel or uncivilized.

words.tr:
adj. 失职的；违法的；拖欠债务的
n. 违犯者；少年罪犯；违法者
words.ex: The delinquent worker ignored his duties.
words.ex_cn: 这位失职的员工忽视了他的职责。
words.en: A delinquent is someone, especially a young person, who commits a crime or breaks the law.

words.tr: adj. 懒惰的；邋遢的；淫荡的
words.ex: He gave a sluttish performance, ignoring his duties.
words.ex_cn: 他表现得很懒惰，忽视了自己的职责。
words.en: If you describe a woman as sluttish, you mean that she is untidy, dirty, or behaves in a sexually immoral way.

words.ex: He tried to retaliate by spreading rumors.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过散布谣言来报复。
words.en: If you retaliate when someone harms or annoys you, you do something which harms or annoys them in return.

words.ex: He was arrested for perpetrating a fraud.
words.ex_cn: 他因实施诈骗而被逮捕。
words.en: If someone perpetrates a crime or any other immoral or harmful act, they do it.

words.ex: He worked hard and prospered in business.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，在商业上取得了成功。
words.en: If people or businesses prosper, they are successful and do well.

words.ex: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船在港口放下了锚。
words.en: An anchor is a heavy object that is dropped from a boat or a ship into the water to prevent the vessel from moving.

words.tr: v. 抢劫；掠夺；蹂躏；破坏
words.ex: The invaders despoiled the village.
words.ex_cn: 入侵者抢劫了村庄。
words.en: To despoil something means to steal from it or damage it, especially in a violent or destructive way.

words.tr: adj. 不礼貌的；失礼的；粗鲁的
words.ex: He was discourteous to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员无礼。
words.en: If you say that someone is discourteous, you mean that they are rude and have no consideration for the feelings of other people.

words.tr: adj. 松弛的；懒散的；马虎的
words.ex: He is lax about his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业很松懈。
words.en: If you say that a person's behaviour or a system is lax, you mean they are not careful or strict about maintaining high standards.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr:
v. 涂抹；弄脏；中伤；诽谤
n. 污迹；污渍；丑化；诽谤
words.ex: He smeared butter on the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他在面包上涂抹了黄油。
words.en: To spread a liquid or a thick substance over a surface, or to damage someone's reputation by telling lies about them.

words.tr: adj. 宽厚的；仁慈的；不严格的；
words.ex: The teacher was lenient with students who were late.
words.ex_cn: 老师对迟到的学生很宽厚。
words.en: If you are lenient with someone, you are not strict in the way you treat them, especially when they have done something wrong.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.tr: v. 制定（法律）；通过（法律）；扮演（角色）
words.ex: The government will enact a new law next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将颁布一项新法律。
words.en: To enact a law or rule means to make it official by passing it through a legislative body.

words.ex: He resents being ignored by his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他怨恨被老板忽视。
words.en: If you resent someone or something, you feel bitter and angry about them.

words.ex: The affluent family bought a big house by the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这个富裕的家庭在湖边买了一栋大房子。
words.en: Having a great deal of money; wealthy.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: Cats and dogs can coexist in the same house.
words.ex_cn: 猫和狗可以在同一个房子里共存。
words.en: To exist together at the same time or in the same place.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.tr: adj. 泛滥的；猖獗的；蔓生的
words.ex: Rumors are rampant in the small town.
words.ex_cn: 谣言在这个小镇上四处流传。
words.en: If you describe something bad, such as a crime or disease, as rampant, you mean that it is very common and is increasing in an uncontrolled way.

words.ex: The prolonged rain caused flooding.
words.ex_cn: 持久的降雨引发了洪水。
words.en: Something that is prolonged continues for a long time, or longer than expected.

words.tr: v. 挤压；压碎；“crush”的现在分词；
words.ex: The machine is crushing the cans.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器正在挤压罐子。
words.en: If you describe something as crushing, you mean that it is very severe or intense.

words.ex: It was futile to try to fix the broken clock.
words.ex_cn: 试图修理坏掉的钟表是徒劳的。
words.en: If you say that something is futile, you mean there is no point in doing it, usually because it has no chance of succeeding.

words.ex: Good teachers edify their students with wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 好老师用智慧启发学生。
words.en: To edify someone means to improve their mind or character by teaching them something.

words.tr: adj. 庸俗的；粗俗的；粗野的；下流的
words.ex: He used a vulgar word in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上说了一个粗俗的词。
words.en: If you describe something as vulgar, you mean that it is in bad taste or of poor quality.

words.tr:
n. 核；核心；重点；
adj. 核心的；
words.ex: The core of the apple is not edible.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的核心不能吃。
words.en: The central or most important part of something.

words.tr: adj. 天生的；先天的；天赋的
words.ex: He has an inborn talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 他天生就有音乐才能。
words.en: An inborn quality or ability is one that you have had naturally since birth.

words.tr: adj. 适合居住的；可居住的；
words.ex: The planet is habitable because it has water and air.
words.ex_cn: 这颗行星有水和空气，适合居住。
words.en: A place that is habitable is suitable or good enough for people to live in.

words.ex: This park is an ecological habitat for many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是许多鸟类的生态栖息地。
words.en: Relating to or concerned with the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.

words.ex: The contract stipulates that payments must be made monthly.
words.ex_cn: 合同规定付款必须按月进行。
words.en: If you stipulate a condition or stipulate that something must be done, you say clearly that it must be done.

words.tr: v. 使（尤其是坏事）合法化；正式批准（或认可）
words.ex: The law will legitimize this practice.
words.ex_cn: 法律将使这种做法合法化。
words.en: To legitimize something means to make it legal or acceptable according to the law.

words.tr: v. 结晶；定形；（使）具体化；变明确
words.ex: The idea began to crystallize after many talks.
words.ex_cn: 经过多次讨论，这个想法开始明朗起来。
words.en: To crystallize means to cause something to form into crystals or to become clear and definite in form.

words.ex: The house uses solar-powered lights.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子使用太阳能供电的灯。
words.en: Powered by solar energy.

words.ex: The small room was cosy with a warm blanket and a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小房间铺着温暖的毯子，喝着热茶，非常舒适。
words.en: A place or situation that is cosy is comfortable and warm.

words.ex: The painter used a roller to apply the paint.
words.ex_cn: 油漆工用滚筒来涂油漆。
words.en: A roller is a cylinder that rotates around a central axis and is used in various machines and devices to move, flatten, or compress something.

words.ex: The kitchen was unsanitary and dirty.
words.ex_cn: 厨房不卫生且脏乱。
words.en: If you describe a place as unsanitary, you mean that it is dirty, and likely to cause disease.

words.ex: The teacher will not condone cheating in exams.
words.ex_cn: 老师不会容忍考试作弊。
words.en: To condone something means to accept or allow behavior that is considered wrong.

words.ex: The storm bereaved the village of its power.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使村庄失去了电力。
words.en: To deprive someone of a loved one through death.

words.tr: adj. 有缺陷的；有故障的；有错误的；
words.ex: The faulty phone keeps turning off.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺陷的手机总是自动关机。
words.en: If you describe something as faulty, you mean that it is not perfect or it has some weaknesses.

words.ex: The ancient symbol remains an enigma.
words.ex_cn: 这个古代符号仍然是一个谜。
words.en: An enigma is something that is mysterious and difficult to understand.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: The word 'bank' has different semantic meanings.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'bank' 有不同的语义含义。
words.en: Semantic is used to describe something that relates to the meanings of words and sentences.

words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何庄稼。
words.en: If you describe something as barren, you mean that it is not able to produce anything, especially plants or crops.

words.tr: adj. 传导的；能传导（热、电）的
words.ex: Copper is conductive and used in wires.
words.ex_cn: 铜具有导电性，用于电线。
words.en: Having the property of conducting something (especially heat or electricity).

words.ex: He is an eccentric man who wears socks with sandals.
words.ex_cn: 他是个古怪的人，穿着袜子配凉鞋。
words.en: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

words.ex: This product is inferior to the other one.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品比另一个差。
words.en: If one person or thing is inferior to another, they are not as good, important, or valuable as the other person or thing.

words.ex: The wind began to slacken after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，风速开始减缓。
words.en: If something slackens or if you slacken it, it becomes slower, less active, or less intense.

words.ex: My mentor helped me choose my career path.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮助我选择了职业道路。
words.en: A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.tr: adj. 没有瑕疵或污点的；完好无损的；
words.ex: The diamond was unblemished and sparkled brightly.
words.ex_cn: 这颗钻石没有瑕疵，闪闪发亮。
words.en: If something is unblemished, it has no faults or marks and is perfect in every way.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: He follows a dietary plan to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循一种饮食计划来保持健康。
words.en: Relating to the diet or the kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

words.tr:
v. 阻碍；妨碍
n. （带盖）篮子
words.ex: Rain hampered our picnic plans.
words.ex_cn: 雨妨碍了我们的野餐计划。
words.en: If something hampers you, it makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.ex: He never disparages his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他从不贬低他的同学。
words.en: If you disparage someone or something, you speak about them in a way which shows that you do not have a good opinion of them.

words.ex: He felt a corporal pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到身体上的疼痛。
words.en: A corporal is a non-commissioned officer in the army, above a private and below a sergeant. As an adjective, it refers to the body or physical condition.

words.tr:
n. （文字）诽谤
v. 发表文字诽谤（某人）
words.ex: He wrote a false story about her, and it was libel.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于她的虚假文章，这是诽谤。
words.en: A libel is a published false statement that is damaging to a person's reputation; a written defamation.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.tr: adj. 对生态环境友好的；不妨害生态环境的
words.ex: She uses eco-friendly bags to shop.
words.ex_cn: 她购物时使用环保袋。
words.en: Eco-friendly refers to goods, services, laws, and guidelines that claim reduced, minimal, or no harm upon ecosystems or the environment.

words.ex: He sent a telegraph to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他给家人发了一封电报。
words.en: A system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection.

words.tr: adj. 插曲般的；由松散片段组成的；不定期发生的；
words.ex: The movie has an episodic structure, with each scene telling a small story.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影具有插曲般的结构，每个场景讲述一个小故事。
words.en: An episodic piece of writing or film consists of a series of separate events or episodes that are linked together.

words.tr:
v. 非法侵入；侵扰；冒犯
n. 非法进入；冒犯
words.ex: He trespasses on private land.
words.ex_cn: 他擅自进入私人土地。
words.en: To trespass is to enter someone's land or property without their permission.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.ex: Children are susceptible to colds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子容易感冒。
words.en: If you are susceptible to something or someone, you are very likely to be influenced by them.

words.ex: The doctor used antiseptic cream on the cut.
words.ex_cn: 医生在伤口上用了防腐药膏。
words.en: An antiseptic is a substance that prevents the growth of disease-causing microorganisms.

words.tr: adj. 懒惰的；懒散的；好逸恶劳的
words.ex: He is indolent and never does his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很懒，从不做作业。
words.en: If you describe someone as indolent, you mean that they are lazy.

words.ex: She is thrifty and saves money every week.
words.ex_cn: 她很节约，每周都存钱。
words.en: If you say that someone is thrifty, you are praising them for saving money and not spending it on unnecessary things.

words.ex: Eating fruits and vegetables is nutritious.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果和蔬菜是有营养的。
words.en: Nutritious food contains substances which help your body to be healthy.

words.tr:
n. 被愚弄的人；容易受骗的人
v. 欺骗；诈骗；愚弄
words.ex: He was duped into buying a fake watch.
words.ex_cn: 他被骗去买了一块假手表。
words.en: A dupe is someone who is easily deceived or cheated, often because they are too trusting. As a verb, to dupe means to deceive or trick someone into believing something that is not true.

words.ex: He overfilled the cup with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子装得水都溢出来了。
words.en: To fill something beyond its capacity or beyond what is necessary.

words.tr: adj. 不容亵渎的；不可侵犯的
words.ex: Her privacy is inviolable.
words.ex_cn: 她的隐私是不可侵犯的。
words.en: If a law or principle is inviolable, it must not be broken or treated without respect.

words.tr: v. 对…予以惩罚；使处于不利地位
words.ex: The teacher will penalize students who cheat.
words.ex_cn: 老师会惩罚作弊的学生。
words.en: To penalize someone means to punish them or make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.tr:
v. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
n. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
words.ex: He spread slander about his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他散布了关于他邻居的诽谤。
words.en: Slander is the action or crime of making a false spoken statement damaging to a person's reputation.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.tr: adj. 品行端正的；品德高的；
words.ex: He is a virtuous man who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个品行端正的人，总是说真话。
words.en: Having or showing high moral standards.

words.tr: adj. 迷信的；有迷信观念的
words.ex: He is superstitious about walking under ladders.
words.ex_cn: 他迷信地认为走过梯子下面会带来厄运。
words.en: Having or showing a belief in superstitions.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: He drank a glass of malt.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一杯麦芽饮料。
words.en: Malt is grain, usually barley, that has been soaked in water, allowed to germinate, and then dried. It is used in brewing and distilling.

words.ex: She works out to augment her strength.
words.ex_cn: 她锻炼以增强力量。
words.en: If you augment something, you make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.

words.ex: The cat is agile and jumps high.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫很敏捷，跳得很高。
words.en: Someone who is agile can move quickly and easily.

words.ex: The tribal people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 部落的人住在森林里。
words.en: Tribal relates to a tribe or tribes.

words.ex: The rain precedes the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雨先于风暴来临。
words.en: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.

words.ex: Drugs can alleviate pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To make something less severe or intense.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: Fishers overexploit the ocean to catch more fish.
words.ex_cn: 渔民过度捕捞海洋以获取更多鱼类。
words.en: To use something excessively, especially natural resources, to the point of causing damage or depletion.

words.tr:
n. 烤架；铁格子
v. 烧烤；拷问
words.ex: He cooked the burgers on the grill.
words.ex_cn: 他用烤架烤了汉堡。
words.en: To cook food on a metal frame over a fire, or a metal frame used for cooking food in this way.

words.tr: v. 反复灌输；谆谆劝导
words.ex: Parents try to inculcate good habits in their children.
words.ex_cn: 父母试图在孩子身上培养良好的习惯。
words.en: To inculcate is to teach and impress by frequent repetitions or admonitions.

words.ex: The storm caused a brutal flood that destroyed many homes.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了残酷的洪水，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A brutal act or person is cruel and violent.

words.tr: v. 报（某事）之仇；为（某人）报仇
words.ex: He wants to avenge his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为弟弟的死报仇。
words.en: To avenge someone means to harm or punish someone who has harmed them or someone they care about.

words.ex: The invasive plant spreads quickly and kills other plants.
words.ex_cn: 这种侵入性植物生长迅速，会杀死其他植物。
words.en: If you describe something as invasive, you mean that it spreads very quickly and is difficult to stop.

words.tr:
v. 提升；提高；改进；
n. 增加；改进；
words.ex: He upgraded his phone to get better performance.
words.ex_cn: 他升级了手机以获得更好的性能。
words.en: To upgrade means to improve the quality or usefulness of something, or to raise it to a higher standard. It can also refer to the process of improving or raising something.

words.tr:
n. 通勤；
v. 通勤；
words.ex: His daily commute takes an hour by train.
words.ex_cn: 他每天的通勤坐火车要一个小时。
words.en: If you commute, you travel a long distance every day between your home and your place of work.

words.tr: adj. 立法的；制定法律的；
words.ex: The legislative branch makes laws.
words.ex_cn: 立法部门制定法律。
words.en: Relating to the making of laws.

words.ex: Can you differentiate between the two colors?
words.ex_cn: 你能区分这两种颜色吗？
words.en: To differentiate means to recognize or express the difference between things or people.

words.tr: adj. 有知觉的；有感觉力的；
words.ex: The robot became sentient and could feel pain.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人变得有知觉，能够感受到疼痛。
words.en: A sentient being is capable of perception or feeling.

words.ex: He poured water into the glass.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进杯子里。
words.en: If you pour a liquid or other substance, you make it flow steadily out of a container by holding the container at an angle.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: He tightened the screw with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 他用扳手把螺丝拧紧。
words.en: If you tighten a rule, policy, or system, you make it stricter or more efficient.

words.tr: adj. 人道的；仁慈的；人文的
words.ex: The shelter treats animals in a humane way.
words.ex_cn: 这个收容所以人道的方式对待动物。
words.en: If you describe something as humane, you mean that it is good and kind, especially because it decreases suffering.

words.ex: The spy tried to infiltrate the enemy base.
words.ex_cn: 间谍试图渗透敌方基地。
words.en: To enter or gain access to (an organization, place, etc.) surreptitiously and gradually, especially in order to acquire secret information.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.ex: His tall height is hereditary from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他高高的身材是遗传自父母的。
words.en: A hereditary characteristic or illness is passed from the genes of a parent to a child.

words.tr: adj. 阴险的；潜伏的；暗中作祟的
words.ex: The insidious virus spread quietly through the town.
words.ex_cn: 这种隐蔽的病毒悄然在小镇蔓延。
words.en: Proceeding in a gradual, subtle way, but with harmful effects.

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.tr: adj. 支持的；支援的；给予帮助的；
words.ex: My parents are supportive when I study hard.
words.ex_cn: 当我努力学习时，我的父母总是支持我。
words.en: If you are supportive, you are kind and helpful to someone at a difficult or unhappy time in their life.

words.ex: He accustoms himself to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己习惯早起。
words.en: If you accustom yourself or someone else to something, you make yourself or them familiar with it or used to it.

words.tr: adj. 不可剥夺（或分割）的
words.ex: Freedom is an inalienable right.
words.ex_cn: 自由是不可剥夺的权利。
words.en: An inalienable right or quality is one that cannot be taken away from you.

words.tr:
v. 品味；细品；享用；体会
n. 风味；滋味
words.ex: He savours every bite of the meal.
words.ex_cn: 他细细品味每一口饭菜。
words.en: To savour something means to enjoy it as much as you can. If you savour an experience or a feeling, you enjoy it as much as you can, for example by noticing all its details.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: The school used to segregate students by race.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校过去按种族隔离学生。
words.en: To segregate means to separate one group of people, animals, or things from another, especially because they are of different types or belong to different categories.

words.tr: adj. 适于耕种的；可耕种的
words.ex: The land is tillable and good for farming.
words.ex_cn: 这块土地可耕种，适合农业。
words.en: Capable of being tilled; suitable for cultivation.

words.ex: Sheep overgraze the land and hurt the grass.
words.ex_cn: 羊群过度放牧，破坏了草地。
words.en: To graze (land) so heavily that the vegetation is damaged and the ground becomes liable to erosion.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.tr: v. 回报；报答；往复；来回
words.ex: She helped me, and I will reciprocate.
words.ex_cn: 她帮了我，我会回报她。
words.en: If your feelings or actions towards someone are reciprocated, the other person feels or behaves in the same way towards you as you have felt or behaved towards them.

words.tr: adj. 濒临死亡的；垂死的；
words.ex: The moribund patient stopped breathing.
words.ex_cn: 这位濒临死亡的病人停止了呼吸。
words.en: If you describe something as moribund, you mean that it is in a very bad condition and is not active or successful.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.ex: She wears modish clothes every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天穿时髦的衣服。
words.en: If something is modish, it is fashionable and modern.

words.ex: He maltreats his dog every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都虐待他的狗。
words.en: To maltreat someone means to treat them cruelly or unkindly.

words.ex: The boy disobeyed his mother.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩违抗了他妈妈。
words.en: If you disobey someone or something, you deliberately do not do what they say or what they tell you to do.

words.tr: adj. 多方面的；有多种技能的；
words.ex: He is a versatile player who can play many positions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名多方面的运动员，能打多个位置。
words.en: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

words.tr:
n. 怨恨；积怨；嫌隙
v. 勉强做；不情愿地给；吝惜
words.ex: He holds a grudge against his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他对他哥哥心怀怨恨。
words.en: A grudge is a persistent feeling of ill will or resentment resulting from a past insult or injury.

words.tr: adj. 自命不凡的；自负的；矫饰的
words.ex: He wore a fancy hat to seem pretentious.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶华丽的帽子，显得自命不凡。
words.en: If you describe something as pretentious, you mean that it is intended to seem important or significant, but you think it is not.

words.tr: v. 参军；入伍；谋求（某人的帮助）
words.ex: He wants to enlist in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他想参军。
words.en: To enlist means to join the military, or to get someone else to join the military. It can also mean to get support or help from someone for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He tried to curb his horse with the reins.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用缰绳勒住马。
words.en: If you curb something, you control it and keep it within limits.

words.tr: n. 精心制作；详尽的细节；
words.ex: The chef gave an elaboration to the dish with fresh herbs.
words.ex_cn: 厨师用新鲜香草对这道菜进行了精心制作。
words.en: The process of developing or presenting a theory, policy, or system in detail.

words.tr: adj. 势利的；谄上欺下的
words.ex: He is snobbish and ignores people who are not rich.
words.ex_cn: 他很势利，不理睬不富有的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as snobbish, you disapprove of them because they are too proud of their social status, intelligence, or taste.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.ex: The prevalence of flu increased in winter.
words.ex_cn: 流感在冬季更加流行。
words.en: The fact or condition of being prevalent; commonness.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.tr:
n. 黄道
adj. 黄道的
words.ex: The ecliptic is the path the sun seems to take across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 黄道是太阳在天空中看起来经过的路径。
words.en: The ecliptic is the apparent path of the Sun on the celestial sphere, and is the basis for the ecliptic coordinate system.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

words.tr: v. 嫉妒；羡慕；不乐意地做（或付出）
words.ex: He begrudges his friend's success.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒朋友的成功。
words.en: If you begrudge something, you feel unhappy or resentful about having to give it, do it, or allow it.

words.tr:
v. 弥漫；
adj. 分散的；
words.ex: Smoke began to diffuse through the room.
words.ex_cn: 烟开始弥漫在整个房间里。
words.en: If something such as knowledge or information is diffused, or if it diffuses, it is made known over a wide area or to a lot of people.

words.ex: The train has a sleeping compartment for passengers.
words.ex_cn: 火车上有一个供乘客休息的隔间。
words.en: A compartment is a separate section or part of something, especially a space in a vehicle that is separated from other spaces.

words.ex: He completed his apprenticeship as a carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了木工学徒期。
words.en: An apprenticeship is a period of time in which someone learns a trade or profession by working under the supervision of a skilled worker.

words.tr: adj. 法定的；依照法规的；
words.ex: The statutory minimum wage is $10 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 法定最低工资是每小时10美元。
words.en: Statutory means relating to rules or laws which have been formally written down.

words.ex: The kitchen is hygienic and clean.
words.ex_cn: 厨房卫生且干净。
words.en: Something that is hygienic is clean and unlikely to cause illness.

words.ex: The traffic came to a standstill during the rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰期交通陷入了停滞。
words.en: A situation in which all activity or movement has stopped.

words.tr: adj. 不稳定的；飘忽不定的；
words.ex: The weather has been erratic this month.
words.ex_cn: 这个月的天气一直不稳定。
words.en: Something that is erratic does not follow a regular pattern, but happens at unexpected times or moves in unexpected directions.

words.ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
words.ex_cn: 邪恶的女巫对王子施了咒语。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wicked, you mean that they are very bad, immoral, or cruel.

words.tr: n. 弹回；反响；后果；反射
words.ex: The ball showed a clear repercussion off the wall.
words.ex_cn: 球从墙上明显地弹回。
words.en: The effect that an action, event, or decision has on something, especially a bad effect.

words.ex: The pattern is geometrical and simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个图案是几何形状的，而且很简单。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.ex: The red hat was conspicuous in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 那顶红帽子在人群中非常显眼。
words.en: Something that is conspicuous is very obvious or easy to notice.

words.ex: This decision is pivotal for the company's future.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对公司未来至关重要。
words.en: Of crucial importance in relation to the development or success of something else.

words.tr: adj. 再发的；循环的； v. “recur”的现在分词；
words.ex: He has a recurring headache every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都会复发头痛。
words.en: Happening or appearing again or repeatedly.

words.ex: The team's morale improved after they won the game.
words.ex_cn: 球队赢了比赛后，士气提升了。
words.en: Morale is the amount of confidence and cheerfulness that a group of people have.

words.ex: The company improved data retention after upgrading its system.
words.ex_cn: 公司在升级系统后提高了数据保留能力。
words.en: The action of retaining something; the continued possession, use, or control of something.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: The plants grow in the conservatory.
words.ex_cn: 植物在温室里生长。
words.en: A conservatory is a room with glass walls and a glass roof, which is built on the side of a house. It is used as a sun lounge or for growing plants. It can also refer to a school where people are trained in music or acting.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.ex: The children love watching animated movies.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢看动画电影。
words.en: Animated means full of life or excitement, or made to appear to move as if by magic or technology.

words.ex: The project cost overrun the budget.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的成本超过了预算。
words.en: If an army or a group of people overruns a place, they take control of it by force. If something such as a place or a piece of land is overrun by things or people, it is filled with them and they spread everywhere.

words.ex: He bought the car on a whim.
words.ex_cn: 他一时兴起买了这辆车。
words.en: A whim is a sudden desire or change of mind, especially one that is unusual or unexplained.

words.ex: He will rectify the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: If you rectify something that is wrong, you change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: He squandered all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他把所有的钱都浪费在游戏上了。
words.en: If you squander money, resources, or opportunities, you waste them in a foolish or careless way.

words.tr: v. 扫；“sweep”的现在分词； adj. 全面的；
words.ex: He sweeping the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上扫地。
words.en: If you describe something as sweeping, you mean it is very extensive or has a very wide effect.

words.ex: He contends that education is the key to success.
words.ex_cn: 他主张教育是成功的关键。
words.en: If you contend with someone or contend with something, you have to deal with a difficult situation or problem. If you contend that something is true, you state or argue that it is true.

words.ex: He accepted liability for the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了事故的责任。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a liability, you mean that they cause a lot of problems or embarrassment.

words.ex: The sick man needs proper aliment to recover.
words.ex_cn: 病人需要适当的食物来康复。
words.en: Aliment refers to food or nourishment that sustains life and promotes health.

words.tr: adj. 无数的；多的；数不清的；
words.ex: There are countless stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有无数颗星星。
words.en: Too numerous to count.

words.tr: n. 修辞学；花言巧语；华丽的文辞；
words.ex: He studied rhetoric to improve his speaking skills.
words.ex_cn: 他学习修辞学以提高自己的演讲能力。
words.en: Rhetoric is the art or study of using language effectively and persuasively.

words.ex: People venerate the ancient sage for his wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 人们因他的智慧而崇敬这位古代圣人。
words.en: To regard with respect or reverence.

words.ex: The actors rehearse their lines every evening.
words.ex_cn: 演员们每天晚上排练他们的台词。
words.en: To rehearse means to practice a play, piece of music, or other work for later public performance.

words.ex: His silence was an implicit apology.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默是一种含蓄的道歉。
words.en: Something that is implicit is expressed in an indirect way.

words.tr: v. 构成…的基础（或起因）
words.ex: Poor diet underlies many health problems.
words.ex_cn: 不良饮食是许多健康问题的根源。
words.en: If something underlies a situation or activity, it is the cause or basis of it.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.tr: adj. 分子的；分子构成的；
words.ex: Water is a molecular compound.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种分子化合物。
words.en: Relating to or consisting of molecules.

words.tr: adj. 逼近的；迫在眉睫的； v. “loom”的现在分词；
words.ex: A looming storm made everyone hurry home.
words.ex_cn: 一场逼近的风暴让所有人都急忙回家。
words.en: If something looms, it appears as a large, unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: The gland secrete sweat to cool the body.
words.ex_cn: 腺体分泌汗液来降温。
words.en: If part of a plant, animal, or human secretes a liquid or substance, it produces it.

words.ex: The tricky question eluded even the best students.
words.ex_cn: 这道难题难倒了即使是最优秀的学生。
words.en: If something that you want eludes you, you fail to obtain it. If you elude someone or something, you avoid them or escape from them.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr: n. 改造（工程）；建筑改造；整修；
words.ex: The refurbishment of the old school took six months.
words.ex_cn: 这所旧学校的改造工程花了六个月。
words.en: The process of repairing and redecorating something, especially a building, to make it more attractive or functional.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.tr: adj. 极好的；令人震惊的； v. “stun”的现在分词；
words.ex: She wore a stunning dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件极好的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Extremely impressive or attractive.

words.ex: He wore a ceremonial robe for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他为婚礼穿了一件仪式性的长袍。
words.en: relating to or used in a ceremony; formal

words.ex: Legends say that some heroes are immortal.
words.ex_cn: 传说有些英雄是不死的。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as immortal, you mean that they are so famous or popular that they will be remembered for a very long time.

words.ex: The baby's neural connections are developing fast.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的神经连接正在迅速发展。
words.en: Neural relates to a nerve or the nervous system.

words.ex: He is bullying his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: The use of strength or influence to harm or intimidate those who are weaker.

words.ex: The baby ingests milk every few hours.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿每隔几小时喝奶。
words.en: To ingest means to take food, drink, or another substance into your body, usually by swallowing.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌烦的；令人烦恼的；
words.ex: The loud noise is bothersome.
words.ex_cn: 这嘈杂的声音令人厌烦。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as bothersome, you mean that they cause bother or difficulties.

words.ex: The cat got entangled in the string.
words.ex_cn: 猫被绳子缠住了。
words.en: If something is entangled in something else, it is caught or twisted around it, or mixed with it so that it is difficult to separate the two things.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.ex: The remnant of the old wall still stands.
words.ex_cn: 这堵旧墙的残余部分仍然矗立着。
words.en: A remnant is a small remaining quantity of something.

words.tr: n. （船只）搁浅；（船只）搁浅 v. 使滞留，使搁浅( strand的现在分词 )；
words.ex: The storm caused the ship's stranding on the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 风暴导致船只在岩石上搁浅。
words.en: The act of leaving someone or something in a place from which it is difficult to escape or be rescued, especially a place that is isolated or inaccessible.

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.ex: The refugees lived in abject poverty.
words.ex_cn: 这些难民过着凄惨的贫困生活。
words.en: Abject means extremely bad, unpleasant, and degrading.

words.ex: The aboriginal people live in the forests of Australia.
words.ex_cn: 土著居民生活在澳大利亚的森林里。
words.en: An aboriginal person or thing is one that has been in a country or region from the earliest known times or from before the arrival of colonists.

words.tr: v. 使适应（新气候或环境）
words.ex: He needs to acclimatize to the hot weather.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应炎热的天气。
words.en: To acclimatize means to adjust to a new climate, environment, or situation.

words.ex: He is a veteran player with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位经验丰富的老练球员。
words.en: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience in a particular field or activity, especially in the armed forces.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.ex: The uptake of nutrients by plants is important for growth.
words.ex_cn: 植物对营养物质的摄取对生长很重要。
words.en: The process by which substances are taken into a cell, organism, or system; the understanding or comprehension of information.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.ex: The dissonant notes made the music sound unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这些不和谐的音符让音乐听起来很难听。
words.en: If something is dissonant, it is not harmonious or consistent; it may refer to sounds that are harsh and unpleasant or to ideas, opinions, or elements that are in disagreement.

words.tr: v. 使根深蒂固；使处于牢固地位；用壕沟围住
words.ex: The habit entrenches itself over time.
words.ex_cn: 这个习惯随着时间的推移变得根深蒂固。
words.en: To establish something very firmly so that it is very difficult to change.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The small village is idyllic with green fields and quiet streams.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄有着绿色的田野和宁静的溪流，十分宁静美好。
words.en: An idyllic place or experience is extremely pleasant, beautiful, and peaceful, often in a way that seems too good to be true.

words.ex: He works on an agricultural farm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个农场工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr: adj. 按时间先后顺序排列的
words.ex: The events are listed in chronological order.
words.ex_cn: 这些事件按时间顺序列出。
words.en: If things are described or shown in chronological order, they are described or shown in the order in which they happened.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.ex: He practices martial arts every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习武术。
words.en: Martial is used to describe things relating to soldiers or war.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.ex: He is adept at solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: Someone who is adept at something is very skilled at it.

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.tr: adj. 逻辑上的；合乎逻辑的；
words.ex: His argument is logical and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点合乎逻辑，容易理解。
words.en: In accordance with the principles of logic; reasonable.

words.ex: The weather is unpredictable today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气不可预测。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

words.tr:
v. 惊异于；惊异；
n. 令人惊异的人（或事）；
words.ex: I marvel at how fast she runs.
words.ex_cn: 我惊异于她跑得有多快。
words.en: If you marvel at something, you express your great surprise, wonder, or admiration.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；惯常的； v. “accustom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you know it so well or have experienced it so often that it seems natural, unsurprising, or easy to deal with.

words.ex: They collaborate to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作完成这个项目。
words.en: to work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor

words.ex: The family reduced their monthly expenditure.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭减少了每月的开支。
words.en: Expenditure is the spending of money on something, or the money that is spent on something.

words.tr: adj. 公正的；不偏不倚的；
words.ex: The judge was impartial in the trial.
words.ex_cn: 法官在审判中是公正的。
words.en: Someone who is impartial is not directly involved in a particular situation, and is therefore able to give a fair opinion or decision about it.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.ex: The operation of the machine is very smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运行非常顺畅。
words.en: An operation is a planned activity involving many people performing various tasks.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
n. 包；包裹；
v. 包装；
words.ex: He bought a package of cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一包饼干。
words.en: A package is a wrapped container or a set of objects wrapped in paper or packed in a box.

words.ex: The artist interweaves colors to make a beautiful pattern.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家将颜色交织在一起，创造出美丽的图案。
words.en: To interweave means to weave or blend together two or more things so that they cannot be separated easily.

words.ex: The child mimics her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If someone or something mimics another person or thing, they try to be like them or copy their behavior or characteristics.

words.tr:
adj. 集体的；
n. 集体；
words.ex: The collective decision was made by all members.
words.ex_cn: 这个集体决定是由所有成员做出的。
words.en: done or shared by all members of a group of people

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.ex: The virus can mutate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒可以迅速变异。
words.en: If an animal or plant mutates, or something mutates it, it develops different characteristics as the result of a change in its genes.

words.ex: Children develop perceptual skills by playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 儿童通过玩玩具发展知觉能力。
words.en: Relating to the ability to interpret or become aware of something through the senses.

words.tr: n. 术语；条款；期间；学期；“term”的复数；
words.ex: The book explains the terms of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书解释了计算机科学的术语。
words.en: Terms refer to the conditions that are set for an agreement or the words used to describe specific things in a particular field.

words.tr:
v. 看待；有关；
n. 尊敬；致意；
words.ex: I regard him as a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 我把他看作好朋友。
words.en: If you regard someone or something as being a particular thing or as having a particular quality, you believe that they are that thing or have that quality.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.tr:
n. 大师；主人；
v. 掌握；精通；
words.ex: He is a master of classical piano.
words.ex_cn: 他是古典钢琴的大师。
words.en: A master is someone who has control over something or someone; a person who is highly skilled in a particular area; or a degree awarded by a university or college.

words.tr:
v. 定罪；宣判有罪
n. 罪犯；囚犯
words.ex: The court convicted him of theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院判定他犯有盗窃罪。
words.en: If someone is convicted of a crime, they are found guilty of that crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The government wants to eradicate poverty.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望消灭贫困。
words.en: To eradicate something means to get rid of it completely.

words.tr: adj. 有独创性的；巧妙的；
words.ex: The child came up with an ingenious way to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子想出了一个有独创性的方式来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.tr:
n. 计划；节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: He made a programme to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个存钱的计划。
words.en: A programme is a plan of activities designed to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.tr: adj. 群体的；社区的；公有的；
words.ex: They share a communal kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 他们共用一个群体厨房。
words.en: Communal means relating to or shared by all the members of a community.

words.tr:
n. 叙述；叙事；
adj. 叙述性的；
words.ex: He told a simple narrative about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的简单故事。
words.en: A narrative is a story or an account of a series of events.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

words.ex: The fireworks at night were a beautiful spectacle.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的烟花是一场美丽的奇观。
words.en: A spectacle is a visually striking performance or display.

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: The motif of love appears in many poems.
words.ex_cn: 爱的主题出现在许多诗歌中。
words.en: A motif is a design or pattern that is used in a piece of art or music, or a theme that is repeated in a work of literature.

words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: The stray dog wandered into the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 这只走失的狗走进了后院。
words.en: If someone or something strays, they wander away from where they are supposed to be.

words.tr: adj. 自发的；自然产生的；
words.ex: The children gave a spontaneous cheer.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自发地欢呼起来。
words.en: Something that is spontaneous is not planned but happens or is done because of a sudden impulse or natural feeling.

words.ex: The dove is a symbolic bird of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征性鸟类。
words.en: If you describe an event, action, or procedure as symbolic, you mean that it represents an important change, although it has little practical effect.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He resisted the temptation to eat cake.
words.ex_cn: 他抵制了吃蛋糕的诱惑。
words.en: If you feel you want to do something or have something, even though you know you really should avoid it, you can refer to this feeling as temptation.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.ex: The room was devoid of any furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间里全无家具。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: The lock has an intricate design.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁有复杂的结构。
words.en: You use intricate to describe something that has many small parts or details.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: He is prone to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If you are prone to a particular problem or characteristic, you are likely to be affected by it or to have it.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: The court will prosecute him for theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院将因盗窃罪起诉他。
words.en: To prosecute means to institute legal proceedings against someone or to carry on a legal action against a defendant in a court of law. It also means to continue with or carry on an activity or enterprise.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: The team celebrated their triumph after winning the match.
words.ex_cn: 球队在赢得比赛后庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr: adj. 有（法律）责任的；有…倾向的；
words.ex: He is liable for the damage caused by his car.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的车造成的损害负有责任。
words.en: If you are liable for something such as a debt or a duty, you are legally responsible for it. If something is liable to happen, it is very likely to happen.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He made a proposition to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了降低税收的建议。
words.en: A proposition is a statement or an idea that people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true.

words.ex: He is stubborn and won't change his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他很顽固，不肯改变主意。
words.en: Someone who is stubborn is determined to do what they want and is very unwilling to change their mind.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.ex: The trip is contingent on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行取决于天气情况。
words.en: A contingent event or situation depends on something else in order to happen or exist.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.ex: He will surrender when he sees the police.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到警察时，他会投降。
words.en: If you surrender, you stop fighting or resisting someone and agree that you have been beaten.

words.tr: adj. 残疾的； v. “disable”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The disabled man uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 这位残疾人使用轮椅行动。
words.en: If someone is disabled, they are unable to use part of their body or mind properly, for example, because of injury or illness.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.ex: The acoustic sense helps us hear sounds around us.
words.ex_cn: 听觉帮助我们听到周围的声音。
words.en: The ability to perceive and interpret sounds, especially in relation to hearing and auditory processing.

words.tr: n. 替代疗法；非传统医学疗法
words.ex: He uses alternative therapy to treat his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他使用替代疗法来治疗背痛。
words.en: A therapeutic approach that is used alongside or instead of conventional medical treatments, often focusing on holistic or natural methods.

words.ex: Dance is an art form that expresses emotion.
words.ex_cn: 舞蹈是一种表达情感的艺术形式。
words.en: An art form is a specific form of artistic expression that is characterized by a particular style or method.

words.tr: phrase. 归因于；把……归咎于；认为……是由于
words.ex_cn: 他们相信努力工作会有回报。
words.en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

words.tr: n. 体育器材；运动设备
words.ex: The school bought new athletic equipment for the gym.
words.ex_cn: 学校为健身房购买了新的体育器材。
words.en: Specialized gear or apparatus used for sports, exercise, or physical training, such as weights, balls, or protective gear.

words.ex: The bar graph shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar graph is a chart that uses bars to show comparisons among categories. The bars can be either horizontal or vertical.

words.tr: phrase. 与…不相容的；与……对立
words.ex: This software may be incompatible with older operating systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件可能与旧的操作系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.ex: The new idea was incorporated into the plan.
words.ex_cn: 这个新想法被纳入了计划中。
words.en: To be included or combined as part of a whole.

words.ex: The weather is independent of my plans.
words.ex_cn: 天气与我的计划无关。
words.en: To not be influenced or controlled by something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 不情愿做某事；不愿做某事
words.ex: She was loath to admit her mistake.
words.ex_cn: 她不愿意承认自己的错误。
words.en: To be unwilling or reluctant to do something.

words.ex: Italy is renowned for its pasta.
words.ex_cn: 意大利因意大利面而闻名。
words.en: To be famous or well known for something.

words.ex: This math problem is unfamiliar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题对他来说不熟悉。
words.en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

words.tr: phrase. 使充气；爆炸；发怒；夸大
words.ex: He blew up the balloon with his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他用嘴把气球吹鼓了。
words.en: If someone blows something up or if it blows up, it is destroyed by an explosion.

words.tr: phrase. 身体语言；肢体语言
words.ex: He smiles and nods, that is positive body language.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑并点头，这是积极的肢体语言。
words.en: The conscious and unconscious movements and postures by which attitudes and feelings are communicated.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 将……分解成；把……分成（部分）
words.ex: We can break down into simple steps.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以将它分解成简单的步骤。
words.en: To separate or analyze something into smaller, simpler parts or components.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: He runs fast and breaks records.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，打破了纪录。
words.en: To achieve a performance or result that surpasses all previous records.

words.ex: I need to chase up the delivery driver.
words.ex_cn: 我需要追上送货司机。
words.en: To chase someone up means to remind or urge them to do something they have promised or are supposed to do.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.ex: Managing a chronic illness requires a comprehensive approach that includes medication, lifestyle changes, and regular check-ups.
words.ex_cn: 管理慢性病需要一个全面的方法，包括药物治疗、生活方式的改变和定期检查。
words.en: A chronic illness is a long-term health condition that may not have a cure. It requires ongoing management and can affect a person's quality of life.

words.ex: He decided to claim compensation for the damage caused by the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他决定对事故造成的损害要求赔偿。
words.en: To demand payment or other remedy for a loss or injury, typically from an insurance company or employer.

words.tr: phrase. 工作中的休息时间；茶歇
words.ex: We took a coffee break at 10 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在上午10点休息喝咖啡。
words.en: A short period of rest from work during which people drink coffee or other beverages.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrase. 开始起作用；开始运转
words.ex: When we solve the problem, teamwork comes into play.
words.ex_cn: 当我们解决问题时，团队合作就发挥作用了。
words.en: To become active or have an effect; to start to operate or be used.

words.ex: He committed a crime last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚犯下一桩罪行。
words.en: To do something illegal or wrong.

words.tr: n. 补充医学；辅助医学（指与传统医学结合使用的非主流医疗方法）
words.ex: He uses complementary medicine to help with his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他使用补充医学来缓解背痛。
words.en: Medical practices used in conjunction with conventional treatments to enhance overall health and well-being, often emphasizing the body's natural healing abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 不知不觉地来临；悄悄靠近
words.ex: Time can creep up on you if you're not careful.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不小心，时间会悄悄溜走。
words.en: To approach someone or something stealthily or gradually, often without being noticed.

words.ex: The old temple is part of our cultural heritage.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙是我们文化遗产的一部分。
words.en: Cultural heritage refers to the legacy of physical artifacts and intangible attributes of a group or society that are inherited from past generations, maintained in the present and bestowed for the benefit of future generations.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于； 把...专用于；致力于…
words.ex: He devotes to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the game because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了决定不参与比赛。
words.en: To leave a school, college, or course of study before you have finished it.

words.tr: n. 地震带；地震活跃区
words.ex: This city is in an earthquake zone.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于地震带。
words.en: A geographical region prone to seismic activity, where earthquakes are more likely to occur due to tectonic plate movements.

words.tr: phrase. 全神贯注于；专心致志于
words.ex: He was engrossed in reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 他全神贯注于读书。
words.en: Deeply absorbed or focused on a particular activity, task, or subject, showing intense concentration and interest.

words.ex: He paid the enrolment fee to join the class.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了注册费以加入班级。
words.en: A fee charged for registering or enrolling in a course, program, or institution.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.ex: She does a facial massage every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上做面部按摩。
words.en: The manual manipulation of facial muscles and tissues to improve circulation, relaxation, and skin tone.

words.tr: phrase. 电影工业；电影产业；电影业
words.ex: He works in the film industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影行业工作。
words.en: The sector involved in the production and distribution of films.

words.ex: We need to finish up our homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们得在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: to complete something or come to the end of an activity

words.tr: phrase. 固定资产；指企业长期使用而不会在短期内转化为现金的资产，如土地、建筑物、设备等
words.ex: The company purchased a new fixed asset to expand its production capacity.
words.ex_cn: 公司购买了一项新的固定资产以扩大其生产能力。
words.en: A fixed asset is a long-term tangible piece of property or equipment that a firm owns and uses in its operations to generate income. Fixed assets are not expected to be consumed or converted into cash within a year.

words.ex: He took out a fixed loan to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔固定利率贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A type of loan with a fixed interest rate and repayment terms that remain unchanged throughout the loan's duration, providing predictable monthly payments.

words.ex: He left the city for good.
words.ex_cn: 他永久离开了这座城市。
words.en: If something changes or disappears for good, it never changes back or comes back as it was before.

words.ex: Cars use fossil fuel to move.
words.ex_cn: 汽车使用化石燃料行驶。
words.en: Fossil fuels are fuels formed by natural processes such as anaerobic decomposition of buried dead organisms, containing energy originating in ancient photosynthesis.

words.ex: The radio shows the frequency spectrum of the signal.
words.ex_cn: 收音机显示了信号的频率谱。
words.en: The range of electromagnetic frequencies used for transmitting signals, such as radio waves, microwaves, and visible light, often analyzed in communications and physics.

words.tr: phrase. 收集数据； gather 表示收集，data 指数据
words.ex: They gather data from the survey every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周从调查中收集数据。
words.en: To collect or accumulate facts, statistics, or information systematically.

words.ex: The gene pool of the island birds is very small.
words.ex_cn: 这些岛屿鸟类的基因库非常小。
words.en: The gene pool is the complete set of unique alleles in a species or population.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 图形说明；图解；形象的描述
words.ex: The book uses a graphic illustration to show how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这本书用一张图形插图来展示植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A graphic illustration is a visual representation used to explain or decorate a text, making complex ideas easier to understand.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.ex: I will have a word with him about his noise.
words.ex_cn: 我会跟他谈谈他的噪音问题。
words.en: To speak to someone briefly, especially in order to give them a warning or to tell them something important.

words.ex: The health system helps people get medical care.
words.ex_cn: 医疗系统帮助人们获得医疗服务。
words.en: A health system, also sometimes referred to as health care system or healthcare system, is the organization of people, institutions, and resources that deliver health care services to meet the health needs of target populations.

words.ex: Herbal medicine has been used for centuries to treat a variety of ailments.
words.ex_cn: 草药医学被用于治疗各种疾病已有数百年历史。
words.en: Herbal medicine refers to the use of plants and plant extracts for therapeutic purposes. It is a form of alternative medicine that has been practiced for centuries across various cultures.

words.ex: History is a historical discipline that studies past events.
words.ex_cn: 历史学是一门研究过去事件的学科。
words.en: An academic field of study focused on examining past events, cultures, and societies through critical analysis of historical sources and evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 历史兴趣；历史价值
words.ex: The old house has historical interest because it was built in 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子具有历史价值，因为它建于1800年。
words.en: Historical interest refers to the curiosity or concern about the past, including events, people, and cultures.

words.tr: phrase. 认真地；诚挚地；正正经经
words.ex: He started working in earnest after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后认真开始工作。
words.en: If you do something in earnest, you do it with serious and sincere intentions.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.ex: In principle, I agree with your proposal, but we need to discuss the details.
words.ex_cn: 原则上，我同意你的提议，但我们需要讨论细节。
words.en: If something is possible in principle, it is theoretically possible, even if it has not been done before.

words.tr: phrase. 自主学习；独立研究（课程）
words.ex: He does independent study every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上进行自主学习。
words.en: A method of learning where the student takes responsibility for their own learning process, often outside of a traditional classroom setting.

words.tr: phrase. 敏锐的视力；清晰的洞察力
words.ex: The eagle has keen vision to spot prey from high up.
words.ex_cn: 鹰有敏锐的视力，可以从高处发现猎物。
words.en: Exceptionally sharp or perceptive eyesight, often metaphorically used to describe keen insight or the ability to notice subtle details.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；拆卸；拍板成交；获得（收入）；降低（价格）；减（量）
words.ex: The strong wind can knock down the small tree.
words.ex_cn: 强风能把小树吹倒。
words.en: To knock someone or something down means to cause them to fall to the ground by hitting them, often with a vehicle or by physical force.

words.ex: The students went to the lecture theatre for biology class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们去讲堂上生物课。
words.en: A large room or hall used for lectures, typically with tiered seating for the audience.

words.tr: phrase. 语言多样性；多种语言共存的状态
words.ex: Linguistic diversity is a crucial aspect of cultural heritage.
words.ex_cn: 语言多样性是文化遗产的一个重要方面。
words.en: Linguistic diversity refers to the variety of languages spoken by people in a particular area or in the world as a whole. It is a measure of the richness of human culture and communication.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.tr: phrase. 魔术戏法；魔法般的把戏
words.ex: The boy showed a magical trick with cards.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩表演了一个用纸牌的神奇魔术。
words.en: An illusion or feat of sleight of hand performed to entertain an audience.

words.ex: He ordered steak as the main course.
words.ex_cn: 他点了牛排作为主菜。
words.en: The main course is the principal dish of a meal, usually following the starter or soup.

words.ex: He made a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: To formally express dissatisfaction or annoyance about something.

words.tr: n. 虚构的世界；幻想的世界
words.ex: Children live in a make-believe world full of dragons and magic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们生活在一个充满龙和魔法的虚构世界里。
words.en: An imaginary or fictional realm used for play or escapism.

words.tr: phrase. 大规模灭绝；物种大灭绝
words.ex: Dinosaurs died in a mass extinction.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙在一次大规模灭绝中灭绝了。
words.en: A catastrophic event in Earth's history where a large percentage of species die out simultaneously, often due to environmental changes.

words.ex: The mass media shows news every day.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various means by which information is communicated to large numbers of people, including newspapers, magazines, television, and the internet.

words.ex: The accident got a lot of media coverage.
words.ex_cn: 这起事故得到了大量的媒体报导。
words.en: The reporting of a particular subject or event by the media.

words.ex: I met up with my old friend at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 我在杂货店偶然碰到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To come together with someone, especially after arranging to do so.
