words.en: The diaphragm is a muscular partition separating the thorax from the abdomen in mammals. It plays a major role in breathing, as its contraction increases the volume of the thorax and so inflates the lungs.

words.ex: Look through the eyepiece to see the stars.
words.ex_cn: 通过目镜看星星。
words.en: The lens or group of lenses that is closest to the eye in a microscope, telescope, or other optical instrument, through which the viewer looks to see the magnified image.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.tr:
v. 过滤；
n. 过滤器；
words.ex: She filters the water before drinking it.
words.ex_cn: 她在喝水之前过滤水。
words.en: A filter is a device or a method that removes unwanted substances from something such as water, air, or light, by passing it through a special material or system.

words.ex: He uses a flashlight to find his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他用手电筒在黑暗中找钥匙。
words.en: A flashlight is a small portable electric light that is powered by batteries and typically has a handle for holding.

words.tr: phrase. 风箱式照相机；折合式照像机；折叠式摄影机
words.ex: He bought a folding camera to take pictures on his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一台折叠相机去旅行时拍照。
words.en: A folding camera is a type of camera that can be folded into a compact shape for easy transport.

words.ex: She added gelatine to make the dessert firm.
words.ex_cn: 她加入了明胶使甜点变硬。
words.en: A clear substance made from animal bones and used in food preparation, especially to make jelly.

words.tr: phrase. 闪光灯指数；闪光指数；闪光次数
words.ex: The guide number of this flash is 30.
words.ex_cn: 这个闪光灯的闪光灯指数是30。
words.en: A number used in photography to indicate the power of a flash unit.

words.tr: n. 持有者；拥有者；支架
words.ex: The holder of the ticket won a prize.
words.ex_cn: 票的持有者中了奖。
words.en: A holder is a person or thing that holds something.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: The photoelectric cell turns light into electricity.
words.ex_cn: 光电管将光转化为电能。
words.en: A device that generates an electric current or voltage when exposed to light, used in various applications such as light meters, solar panels, and automatic doors.

words.ex: He uses a photometer to measure light intensity.
words.ex_cn: 他使用光度计来测量光强度。
words.en: A photometer is an instrument for measuring the intensity of light.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: He put the plates on the plateholder after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后把盘子放在盘子架上。
words.en: A device in a camera that holds the photographic plate or film in position.

words.ex: His sensitivity to loud noises makes him wear earplugs.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音的敏感性让他戴耳塞。
words.en: Sensitivity is the quality or condition of being sensitive—the capacity to respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter release to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门释放按钮来拍照。
words.en: A shutter release is a button or mechanism on a camera that is pressed to open the shutter and take a photograph.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.tr:
n. 线轴；缠线框
v. 缠绕；卷在线轴上
words.ex: The thread wound around the spool.
words.ex_cn: 线缠在了线轴上。
words.en: A spool is a round object onto which thread, tape, or film can be wound, or the act of winding it onto such an object.

words.tr:
n. 聚光灯；
v. 使公众注意；
words.ex: The spotlight shone on the singer during the concert.
words.ex_cn: 演唱会上，聚光灯照在歌手身上。
words.en: A spotlight is a powerful light, for example in a theatre, which can be directed so that it lights up a small area. If someone or something is in the spotlight, they are getting a lot of attention from the public and the media.

words.tr: phrase. 照相机；静物摄影机；静物照相机
words.ex: He uses a still camera to take photos of birds.
words.ex_cn: 他用静物相机拍摄鸟类的照片。
words.en: A still camera is a device used to take photographs, capturing still images as opposed to moving images.

words.tr:
n. 压力；（动植物的）品种；
v. 竭力；
words.ex: The job gave him a lot of strain.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作给他带来了很大的压力。
words.en: To strain means to make a great effort to do something, to pull or stretch something tightly, or to injure a muscle by stretching it too much.

words.ex: She held a sunshade to block the bright sun.
words.ex_cn: 她撑着一把遮阳伞来挡住刺眼的阳光。
words.en: A sunshade is an object or device that provides protection from the sun's rays, typically consisting of a fabric canopy supported by a frame.

words.tr:
n. 测距仪；遥测发射器
v. 遥测；用遥测发射器传送；遥测并传送数据
words.ex: The satellite uses a telemeter to send data to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星使用遥测仪向地球发送数据。
words.en: A telemeter is an instrument used for measuring distances, especially in surveying and in the military, by means of the time it takes for a signal to travel to a target and back.

words.ex: He put the camera on a tripod.
words.ex_cn: 他把相机放在三脚架上。
words.en: A tripod is a three-legged stand or support, especially for a camera or telescope.

words.ex: He looked through the viewfinder to frame the photo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过取景器构图拍照。
words.en: A viewfinder is a device on a camera that shows the area of the subject that will be included in the photograph.

words.ex: He uses a wide-angle lens to take photos of big landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 他使用广角镜头拍摄大片风景。
words.en: A wide-angle lens is a lens that allows a camera to capture a wider field of view than a normal lens, making it ideal for photographing landscapes and large groups.

words.ex: He uses a zoom lens to take pictures of birds.
words.ex_cn: 他使用变焦镜头拍摄鸟类。
words.en: A zoom lens is a type of camera lens that allows the photographer to adjust the focal length, thereby changing the magnification of the image without changing the position of the camera.

words.tr: adj. 多方面的；有多种技能的；
words.ex: He is a versatile player who can play many positions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名多方面的运动员，能打多个位置。
words.en: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

words.ex: He is learning alchemy from an old book.
words.ex_cn: 他正从一本旧书中学习炼金术。
words.en: Alchemy is an ancient practice that aimed to transform base metals into gold and to discover a universal cure for disease and a way of extending life.

words.ex: He works in metallurgy at a steel factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在钢铁厂从事冶金工作。
words.en: Metallurgy is the scientific study of the extraction, refining, alloying, and fabrication of metals and of their structure and properties.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.tr: n. 钻孔，井眼；（为探测石油或水）地上凿洞
words.ex: The workers drilled a deep borehole to find water.
words.ex_cn: 工人们钻了一个深井来寻找水。
words.en: A borehole is a deep narrow hole made in the ground, especially to locate water or oil.

words.ex: The electrode conducts electricity in the battery.
words.ex_cn: 电极在电池中传导电流。
words.en: An electrode is a conductor through which electricity enters or leaves an object, substance, or region.

words.ex: The battery gives out 9 volts.
words.ex_cn: 这节电池输出9伏特。
words.en: A volt is a unit used to measure the force of an electric current.

words.tr: v. 蒸馏；用蒸馏法提取；蒸馏出；提炼
words.ex: They distill water to remove impurities.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过蒸馏去除水中的杂质。
words.en: To distill a liquid means to purify it by heating it until it becomes a gas and then cooling it so that it becomes a liquid again. This process can also be used to extract the essential elements or meanings from something.

words.ex: The plant uses desalination to make seawater drinkable.
words.ex_cn: 该工厂使用脱盐作用将海水变为可饮用水。
words.en: The process of removing salt from seawater to make it suitable for drinking or irrigation.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.ex: Phosphorus is in some fertilizers.
words.ex_cn: 磷存在于一些肥料中。
words.en: Phosphorus is a chemical element with the symbol P and atomic number 15. It is a nonmetal that is essential for life, found in DNA, RNA, ATP, and the phospholipids that form all cell membranes.

words.ex: The sign says the material is inflammable.
words.ex_cn: 标志上说这种材料是易燃的。
words.en: Easily set on fire; capable of burning quickly and intensely.

words.tr:
n. 陶瓷制品；陶瓷器；
adj. 陶质的；制陶的；
words.ex: He bought a ceramic bowl at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个陶瓷碗。
words.en: Ceramic is a hard material that is made by baking clay or similar substances at high temperatures. It is used to make things such as tiles, dishes, and statues.

words.tr: v. 隔离；使隔热；使隔音；使绝缘
words.ex: The walls insulate the house from cold air.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁将房子与冷空气隔离开。
words.en: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, noise, or electricity by covering it in a material that prevents it from passing through.

words.ex: He eats fiber to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他吃纤维来保持健康。
words.en: A fiber is a thread or a structure or object resembling a thread, especially one that is used to make cloth or rope.

words.ex: He is learning optics in physics class.
words.ex_cn: 他正在物理课上学习光学。
words.en: Optics is the branch of physics that involves the study of light and its interactions with matter, including the construction of instruments that use or detect it.

words.ex: The doctor checked his retina with a special light.
words.ex_cn: 医生用特殊的光检查了他的视网膜。
words.en: The retina is the layer at the back of the eyeball that is sensitive to light and sends signals to the brain about what is seen.

words.ex: The iris of her eye is blue.
words.ex_cn: 她的眼睛虹膜是蓝色的。
words.en: The iris is a flat, colored, ring-shaped membrane behind the cornea of the eye, with an adjustable circular opening (pupil) in the center.

words.tr: adj. 不透明的；难懂的；晦涩的
words.ex: The glass is opaque, so I cannot see through it.
words.ex_cn: 这扇玻璃是不透明的，所以我看不到它后面的东西。
words.en: If an object or substance is opaque, you cannot see through it.

words.tr: n. 微处理器；微处理机
words.ex: The computer has a fast microprocessor.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有一个快速的微处理器。
words.en: A microprocessor is a small chip that can process data and carry out instructions in a computer or other electronic device.

words.ex: The computer uses binary code to process data.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用二进制代码来处理数据。
words.en: Relating to, composed of, or involving two things.

words.ex: The computer uses an algorithm to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用一个算法来解决问题。
words.en: An algorithm is a set of rules or instructions that are followed in calculations or other problem-solving operations, especially by a computer.

words.ex: The computer uses a buffer to store data temporarily.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用缓冲区临时存储数据。
words.en: A buffer is something that prevents something else from being harmed or that reduces the impact of something.

words.ex: He uses Chrome as his browser.
words.ex_cn: 他用 Chrome 作为他的浏览器。
words.en: A browser is a piece of computer software that you use to search for information on the Internet.

words.ex: He clicked on the hypertext link to find more information.
words.ex_cn: 他点击了超链接以查找更多信息。
words.en: A system of organizing information through links, allowing users to navigate between related documents or sections of text.

words.ex: The reticular fibers hold the organs in place.
words.ex_cn: 网状纤维将器官固定在位。
words.en: Resembling a net or network; netlike.

words.ex: He connected his computer to the ethernet cable.
words.ex_cn: 他把电脑连接到以太网电缆上。
words.en: Ethernet is a system for connecting a number of computer systems to form a local area network, with protocols to control the passing of information and to avoid simultaneous transmission by two or more systems.

words.ex: He uses a modem to connect to the internet.
words.ex_cn: 他使用调制解调器连接互联网。
words.en: A modem is a device that enables a computer to transmit data over, for example, telephone or cable lines. Computer information is stored digitally, whereas information transmitted over telephone lines is transmitted in the form of analog waves.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.ex: The flowers in the garden are artificial.
words.ex_cn: 花园里的花是人造的。
words.en: Made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally, especially as a copy of something natural.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.tr: adj. 液压的；流体的；利用液体压力的；
words.ex: The hydraulic brake system stops the car quickly.
words.ex_cn: 液压制动系统能快速让汽车停下。
words.en: Hydraulic refers to the operation of machinery or systems by the movement and force of liquid, especially water or oil.

words.tr: n. 垃圾填埋（场）；垃圾堆填（区）；
words.ex: The city built a new landfill outside the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市在城外建了一个新的垃圾填埋场。
words.en: A landfill is a place where waste is buried under the ground.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.ex: He drew a geometric shape on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个几何图形。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.ex: The painting has asymmetry in its design.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的构图不对称。
words.en: The quality of being asymmetrical; lack of symmetry.

words.ex: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项双边协议。
words.en: Involving or affecting two parties, countries, etc.

words.tr: n. 可能发生的情况；设想；
words.ex: It's a possible scenario that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天会下雨是一个可能发生的情况。
words.en: A scenario is a description of a possible course of action or events.

words.ex: The ball followed a smooth trajectory.
words.ex_cn: 球沿着一条平滑的轨迹飞行。
words.en: The path followed by a projectile flying or an object moving under the action of given forces.

words.ex: His argument is based on a fallacy.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点基于一个谬误。
words.en: A fallacy is an idea which many people believe to be true, but which is in fact false because it is based on incorrect information or reasoning.

words.ex: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
words.ex_cn: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。
words.en: The act of finding something that had not been known before.

words.ex: The movie shows an apocalyptic future after a big war.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影描绘了大战之后预示未来灾难的景象。
words.en: Relating to or predicting the end of the world, especially as described in the Bible.

words.ex: He wrote his testament before he died.
words.ex_cn: 他在去世前立了遗嘱。
words.en: A testament is a statement of belief or a document that serves as proof or evidence of something.

words.tr: adj. 增进知识的；提供消息的；
words.ex: The documentary is very informative.
words.ex_cn: 这部纪录片非常增进了知识。
words.en: Providing useful or interesting information.

words.ex: The new policy is problematic for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策对小企业来说成问题。
words.en: If something is problematic, it involves problems and is difficult to deal with or solve.

words.ex: The pediatrician checks the child's health every month.
words.ex_cn: 儿科医生每个月检查孩子的健康状况。
words.en: A pediatrician is a doctor who specializes in the care of children and their diseases.

words.ex: She visited a gynecologist for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 她去看妇科医生做检查。
words.en: A gynecologist is a doctor who specializes in women's health, particularly the health of the female reproductive system.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr: n. 神经病学家；神经科专门医师
words.ex: The neurologist checked his brain with a machine.
words.ex_cn: 神经科医生用机器检查了他的大脑。
words.en: A neurologist is a doctor who specializes in the study and treatment of disorders of the nervous system.

words.tr: n. 精神病学家；精神科医生
words.ex: He visits a psychiatrist every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去看一次精神科医生。
words.en: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.ex: He is learning neuroscience at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习神经科学。
words.en: The scientific study of the nervous system, especially the brain.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: The anesthetist gave the patient medicine before surgery.
words.ex_cn: 麻醉师在手术前给病人用了药。
words.en: An anesthetist is a medical specialist who administers anesthetics.

words.ex: He went to the clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去诊所做检查。
words.en: A clinic is a place where people receive medical treatment or advice, especially for a particular illness or condition.

words.ex: He went to the sanatorium to rest and get better.
words.ex_cn: 他去疗养院休息并康复。
words.en: A sanatorium is an institution for the medical treatment and recuperation of people who are chronically ill.

words.ex: Eating wholesome food helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 吃有益身心的食物有助于保持健康。
words.en: Conducive to or suggestive of good health and physical well-being.

words.ex: Good hygiene helps prevent sickness.
words.ex_cn: 良好的卫生有助于预防疾病。
words.en: Hygiene refers to conditions and practices that help to maintain health and prevent the spread of diseases.

words.ex: The study uses a new methodology to collect data.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用了一种新的方法论来收集数据。
words.en: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.

words.ex: Wear a helmet as a precaution when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔作为一种预防措施。
words.en: A precaution is an action that is intended to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening.

words.tr: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
words.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。
words.en: To vaccinate someone is to give them a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

words.ex: He had a check-up at the hospital last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周在医院做了体检。
words.en: A check-up is a medical examination by your doctor to make sure that there is nothing wrong with your health.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: She showed great affection for her little dog.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的小狗非常钟爱。
words.en: A feeling of liking and caring for someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: He caught influenza last winter.
words.ex_cn: 他去年冬天得了流感。
words.en: Influenza is an infectious disease caused by the influenza virus, characterized by fever, sore throat, muscle pain, severe headache, coughing, and weakness.

words.ex: He has an ulcer from eating too much spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多辣食而得了溃疡。
words.en: An ulcer is a sore area on the skin or inside the body that is very painful and may bleed or produce a poisonous substance.

words.tr: n. 损害；身体上的伤害
words.ex: The doctor found a lesion on his skin.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的皮肤上发现了一个病灶。
words.en: A lesion is an area of damage to the body, such as a wound, ulcer, or tumor.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: The volcano had a big eruption last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周这座火山发生了大喷发。
words.en: An eruption is a sudden, often violent, outburst or discharge, such as that of a volcano, emotion, or conflict.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr: n. 皮肤上的红色小疱
words.ex: He has a small pimple on his nose.
words.ex_cn: 他鼻子上有个小痘痘。
words.en: A pimple is a small raised spot on the skin that is often red and may contain pus.

words.ex: He has a blackhead on his nose.
words.ex_cn: 他的鼻子上有一个黑头。
words.en: A blackhead is a small, dark spot on the skin caused by a blocked hair follicle.

words.ex: He got a blister on his foot from new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他新鞋磨出了一个水泡。
words.en: A blister is a small pocket of fluid within the upper layers of the skin, typically caused by forceful rubbing, burning, freezing, chemical exposure or infection. As a verb, it means to form such a pocket of fluid.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.ex: He has a wart on his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他手上有一个疣。
words.en: A wart is a small, hard, benign growth on the skin, caused by a virus.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.tr: v. 擦伤；挫伤；出现伤痕；
words.ex: He bruised his knee when he fell off the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他从自行车上摔下来时擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: A bruise is a mark that appears on your skin after you have been injured, but the skin is not broken.

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.tr: v. 膨胀；肿胀；“swell”的现在分词；
words.ex: The wound is swelling after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 受伤后伤口在肿胀。
words.en: An abnormal enlargement of a part of the body, typically as a result of an accumulation of fluid.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.ex: The doctor made a diagnosis after checking the symptoms.
words.ex_cn: 医生在检查了症状后做出了诊断。
words.en: The identification of the nature of an illness or other problem by examination of the symptoms.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.tr:
n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声
v. 打喷嚏
words.ex: He had a cold and let out a loud sneeze.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，打了一个响亮的喷嚏。
words.en: To sneeze is to suddenly expel air from the nose and mouth due to irritation in the nasal passages.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.tr: n. 头晕；昏眩；头昏眼花
words.ex: He felt dizziness after standing up quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他站起来后感到头晕。
words.en: A sensation of spinning around and losing one's balance.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.ex: He may lose consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后可能会失去意识。
words.en: To stop being aware of what is happening around you, often because of illness or injury.

words.ex: He brought his friend around to the new idea slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地让朋友接受了这个新想法。
words.en: To persuade someone to agree with you or to do what you want; to cause someone to regain consciousness; to cause someone to change their opinion or decision.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: He takes melatonin to sleep better at night.
words.ex_cn: 他服用褪黑素以更好地入睡。
words.en: A hormone secreted by the pineal gland that regulates sleep and wakefulness.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: He feels weak because he has anemia.
words.ex_cn: 他感到虚弱，因为他患有贫血。
words.en: A condition in which there is a deficiency of red cells or of haemoglobin in the blood, resulting in pallor and weariness.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: The swollen area is inflammatory and painful.
words.ex_cn: 这个肿胀的部位是发炎的，并且很痛。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behaviour as inflammatory, you mean that it is likely to cause people to react very angrily.

words.ex: He has arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手有关节炎。
words.en: Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

words.ex: Osteoporosis is a condition characterized by weak and brittle bones.
words.ex_cn: 骨质疏松症是一种以骨骼脆弱和易碎为特征的病症。
words.en: Osteoporosis is a medical condition in which the bones become brittle and fragile from loss of tissue, typically as a result of hormonal changes, or deficiency of calcium or vitamin D.

words.ex: He put deodorant on his armpit.
words.ex_cn: 他在腋窝上涂了止汗剂。
words.en: The hollow under the arm at the shoulder.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.ex: He hurt his thigh while running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步时伤了大腿。
words.en: The part of the human leg between the hip and the knee.

words.ex: He has bronchitis and can't stop coughing.
words.ex_cn: 他得了支气管炎，一直止不住咳嗽。
words.en: Bronchitis is an illness in which the bronchial tubes become inflamed and produce a lot of mucus, causing coughing and difficulty in breathing.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with cancer last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有癌症。
words.en: Cancer is a serious disease caused by cells that are not normal and that can spread to other parts of the body.

words.ex: He ate too much and had indigestion.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，导致消化不良。
words.en: Indigestion is pain or discomfort in your stomach, usually after eating, which is caused by difficulty in digesting food.

words.ex: The doctor checked his bowel for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The lower part of the alimentary canal from the end of the stomach to the anus.

words.ex: The doctor checked his gut for signs of infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的肠道是否有感染迹象。
words.en: The gut refers to the stomach and other internal organs of an animal or person, often used to describe the digestive tract. It can also metaphorically represent courage or determination.

words.ex: He has leukemia and takes medicine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有白血病，每天吃药。
words.en: Leukemia is a type of cancer that affects the blood and bone marrow, characterized by an abnormal increase in white blood cells.

words.ex: He has diabetes and must check his blood every day.
words.ex_cn: 他患有糖尿病，必须每天检查血糖。
words.en: A medical condition in which the body cannot produce enough insulin or cannot use insulin properly, leading to high levels of sugar in the blood.

words.ex: He had measles when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时得了麻疹。
words.en: An infectious disease that causes fever and small red spots on the skin.

words.ex: The accident caused paralysis in his legs.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故导致他双腿瘫痪。
words.en: Paralysis is the loss of the ability to move and sometimes to feel anything in part or most of the body, typically as a result of illness, poison, or injury.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.tr: n. 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症
words.ex: He had poliomyelitis as a child.
words.ex_cn: 他小时候得了脊髓灰质炎。
words.en: Poliomyelitis, often called polio, is a highly infectious disease caused by a virus that invades the nervous system and can lead to paralysis.

words.ex: The dog has rabies.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗得了狂犬病。
words.en: Rabies is a serious disease that affects the brain and nerves, usually caught from the bite of an infected animal.

words.ex: He had scarlet fever when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时得了猩红热。
words.en: Scarlet fever is an infectious disease characterized by a bright red rash and high fever, caused by the same bacteria responsible for strep throat.

words.ex: Smallpox caused many deaths in the past.
words.ex_cn: 天花在过去导致了许多人死亡。
words.en: An acute, highly infectious, often fatal disease caused by a poxvirus and characterized by high fever and aches with subsequent widespread eruption of pimples that blister, produce pus, and form pockmarks.

words.tr: phrase. 疟疾；[兽医] 马传染性贫血
words.ex: He got swamp fever after walking in the wet forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在湿漉漉的森林里走路后得了疟疾。
words.en: Swamp fever, also known as equine infectious anemia, is a viral disease transmitted by mosquitoes that affects horses, characterized by symptoms such as high fever, anemia, and jaundice.

words.ex: The doctor found a tumour in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个肿瘤。
words.en: A tumour is a mass of tissue that's formed by an accumulation of abnormal cells. Normally, the cells in your body age, die, and are replaced by new cells. With cancer and other tumours, something disrupts this cycle. Tumour cells grow, even though the body does not need them, and unlike normal old cells, they don't die. As this process goes on, the tumour continues to grow as more and more cells are added to the mass.

words.ex: Dopamine makes us feel happy when we succeed.
words.ex_cn: 当我们成功时，多巴胺让我们感到快乐。
words.en: A neurotransmitter in the brain that is involved in the regulation of movement, emotion, motivation, and pleasure.

words.ex: Lipoproteins play a crucial role in transporting fats in the blood.
words.ex_cn: 脂蛋白在血液中运输脂肪过程中起着至关重要的作用。
words.en: A lipoprotein is a biochemical assembly whose primary purpose is to transport hydrophobic lipid molecules in water, as in blood plasma or other extracellular fluids.

words.ex: Scientists mapped the human genome last year.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们去年绘制了人类基因组。
words.en: The complete set of genes or genetic material present in a cell or organism.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: The doctor gave him anesthesia before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给他打了麻醉。
words.en: Anesthesia is the use of drugs to prevent pain during surgery or other medical procedures.

words.ex: The baby cried until she gave him the pacifier.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝哭了，直到她给了他安抚奶嘴。
words.en: A pacifier is an object that a baby sucks on to calm down or stop crying.

words.ex: He needed a blood transfusion after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后需要输血。
words.en: The process of transferring blood or blood-based products from one person into the circulatory system of another.

words.ex: The medicine enters the bloodstream quickly.
words.ex_cn: 药物很快进入血液。
words.en: The bloodstream is the blood flowing in the body's circulatory system.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.ex: The doctor put in ten stitches to close the wound.
words.ex_cn: 医生缝了十针来缝合伤口。
words.en: Stitches are the pieces of thread that have been used to sew the edges of a wound together.

words.ex: The surgeon works in the operating theatre.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生在手术室工作。
words.en: An operating theatre is a room in a hospital where surgeons carry out medical operations.

words.ex: The lab has many scientific instruments.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有许多科学仪器。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.ex: The doctor uses a scalpel to cut the skin.
words.ex_cn: 医生用手术刀切开皮肤。
words.en: A scalpel is a small, extremely sharp knife used for surgery, anatomical dissection, and various arts and crafts.

words.ex: The robot uses a sensor to detect walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用传感器来检测墙壁。
words.en: A sensor is a device which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: The spider caught a fly in its gauze.
words.ex_cn: 蜘蛛在它的网里捉住了一只苍蝇。
words.en: Gauze is a thin, translucent fabric with a loose open weave, used for surgical dressings and other purposes.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: He compresses the file to save space.
words.ex_cn: 他压缩文件以节省空间。
words.en: To compress something means to press it or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

words.ex: He put a sticking plaster on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他把一块创可贴贴在了受伤的手指上。
words.en: A sticking plaster is a small piece of sticky material used for covering small cuts or sores on the skin.

words.tr:
n. 灰泥；
v. 涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；
words.ex: The wall was covered with white plaster.
words.ex_cn: 墙壁上覆盖着白色灰泥。
words.en: A substance applied to walls or ceilings to smooth or decorate them, or a medical dressing used to cover wounds.

words.ex: He is bedridden after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后卧床不起。
words.en: If someone is bedridden, they are so ill or disabled that they cannot get out of bed.

words.tr:
n. 母亲身份；
adj. 产妇的；
words.ex: She enjoys her maternity after giving birth to her first child.
words.ex_cn: 她在生下第一个孩子后享受做母亲的身份。
words.en: Maternity refers to the state of being a mother or the period during which a woman is pregnant or has recently given birth.

words.ex: The neonatal unit cares for newborn babies.
words.ex_cn: 新生儿病房照顾新生儿。
words.en: Neonatal is used to describe things relating to newborn babies, especially the first few weeks after they are born.

words.tr: adj. 顺从的；服从的；恭顺的；
words.ex: The submissive dog waited quietly for its owner's command.
words.ex_cn: 这只顺从的狗安静地等待主人的命令。
words.en: If you are submissive, you obey someone without arguing.

words.tr: v. 使衰弱；使虚弱；“debilitate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The illness was debilitating her strength.
words.ex_cn: 这场疾病正在使她的体力衰弱。
words.en: If you say that a disease or condition is debilitating, you mean that it makes people physically or mentally weak.

words.tr: adj. 死去了的；已死的；亡故的； v. “decease”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The deceased man was buried last week.
words.ex_cn: 这位已故的男子上周被埋葬了。
words.en: Someone who is deceased has died.

words.ex: Sodium hydroxide is a strong base.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种强碱。
words.en: A hydroxide is a chemical compound containing an oxygen atom bonded to a hydrogen atom, which can dissociate in water to produce hydroxide ions.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: Limestone contains calcium carbonate.
words.ex_cn: 石灰石含有碳酸钙。
words.en: A carbonate is a salt of carbonic acid, containing the anion CO₃²⁻, or the compound CO₂ combined with a metal.

words.ex: Glutamate is a natural flavor in many foods.
words.ex_cn: 谷氨酸是许多食物中的天然风味物质。
words.en: A salt or ester of glutamic acid, especially one that functions as a neurotransmitter.

words.ex: Lye is a strong alkali used in cleaning.
words.ex_cn: 氢氧化钠是一种用于清洁的强碱。
words.en: An alkali is a chemical compound that neutralizes acids to form salts and turns red litmus paper blue.

words.ex: Glycerine is used in many skin creams.
words.ex_cn: 甘油被用于许多护肤霜中。
words.en: Glycerine is a thick, sweet, colorless liquid that is used in making medicines, explosives, and antifreeze, and in food and skin care products.

words.ex: Toothpaste contains fluoride to protect teeth.
words.ex_cn: 牙膏含有氟化物以保护牙齿。
words.en: Fluoride is a chemical compound that contains fluorine. It is often added to water and toothpaste to help prevent tooth decay.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.tr: phrase. 物物交换；职业介绍所
words.ex: They used a labour exchange to trade bread for shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过物物交换用面包换鞋子。
words.en: A labour exchange is an office where people looking for work are matched with employers who have jobs available.

words.ex: The departmental meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 部门会议早上九点开始。
words.en: Relating to a department or departments within an organization.

words.ex: The government wants full employment for all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望所有公民都能实现充分就业。
words.en: Full employment is a situation in which all or nearly all persons willing and able to work at prevailing wages and conditions are employed.

words.tr: n. 计件工作；按件计酬的工作
words.ex: He gets paid by piecework, earning $5 for each item he makes.
words.ex_cn: 他按计件工资领取报酬，每制作一个物品赚5美元。
words.en: Piecework is a type of employment in which workers are paid according to the number of items they produce, rather than the amount of time they spend working.

words.ex: He does timework at the factory to earn extra pay.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂做计时工作以赚取额外收入。
words.en: Work that is paid for by the hour or day, rather than by the piece or task.

words.tr: phrase. 组装线工作，流水线作业
words.ex: He does assembly line work in a car factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在汽车工厂做流水线工作。
words.en: Work that is done on an assembly line, where a product is assembled as it passes through a line of workers or machines.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.ex: He wants a short-term job before going to university.
words.ex_cn: 他在上大学之前想找一份短期工作。
words.en: relating to a period of time that is not long, especially a few weeks or months

words.ex: He saves money for long-term goals.
words.ex_cn: 他为长期目标存钱。
words.en: Something that is long-term has continued for a long time or will continue for a long time in the future.

words.ex: He got a work permit to work in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了在加拿大工作的许可证。
words.en: A work permit is an official document giving someone the right to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: The clerk at the store helped me find the book.
words.ex_cn: 商店里的职员帮我找到了那本书。
words.en: A clerk is a person whose job is to keep records or accounts in an office, shop, or bank.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: The choreographer taught the dancers new moves.
words.ex_cn: 舞蹈指导教舞者新的动作。
words.en: A choreographer is a person who designs and directs the dance movements in a ballet, show, or film.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.

words.ex: The ethnobotanist studied the traditional uses of plants by indigenous tribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位民族植物学家研究了土著部落对植物的传统用途。
words.en: An ethnobotanist is a scientist who studies the relationships between people and plants, particularly the traditional knowledge and uses of plants by different cultures.

words.ex: The agronomist helped farmers grow better crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农艺学家帮助农民种植更好的作物。
words.en: An agronomist is a scientist who specializes in soil management and crop production.

words.tr: n. 民俗学者；民间传说研究者
words.ex: The folklorist collects old stories from villages.
words.ex_cn: 民俗学家收集村庄里的古老故事。
words.en: A folklorist is a person who studies folklore, which includes the traditions, customs, and stories of a community, passed through the generations by word of mouth.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The rower practices every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位划船运动员每天早上练习。
words.en: A person who rows a boat, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.ex: The journalist wrote a story about the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 记者写了一篇关于地震的文章。
words.en: A journalist is a person whose job is to collect news and write about it for newspapers, magazines, television, or radio.

words.ex: He is an ambassador to France.
words.ex_cn: 他是驻法国的大使。
words.en: An ambassador is an official envoy, especially a high-ranking diplomat who represents a state and is usually accredited to another sovereign state or to an international organization as the resident representative of their own government or sovereign or appointed for a special and often temporary diplomatic assignment.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.tr: n. 小修道院；小女修道院
words.ex: The ancient priory was converted into a luxury hotel.
words.ex_cn: n. 这座古老的小修道院被改造成了一家豪华酒店。
words.en: A priory is a small monastery or nunnery that is governed by a prior or prioress.

words.tr: n. 神龛；神社；圣地；圣殿
words.ex: People visit the shrine to pray.
words.ex_cn: 人们去神社祈祷。
words.en: A shrine is a place of worship which is associated with a particular holy person or object.

words.ex: The priest said a prayer for the sick.
words.ex_cn: 牧师为病人祈祷。
words.en: A priest is a person who is qualified to perform religious duties and ceremonies in a Christian church.

words.ex: He submitted his application for the job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周提交了那份工作申请。
words.en: An application is a formal request, often written, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something. It can also refer to the act of putting something to a special use or purpose, or a program or piece of software designed to perform a specific function.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 劳动合同；工作合同
words.ex: He signed a work contract last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周签了一份劳动合同。
words.en: A work contract is a legal agreement between an employer and an employee that outlines the terms and conditions of employment.

words.tr: phrase. 身份证；“identity card”的缩写
words.ex: He showed his id card at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的身份证。
words.en: An ID card is a card with a person's name, photograph, date of birth, and other information on it, which proves who they are.

words.ex: He carries a briefcase to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带着公文包去上班。
words.en: A briefcase is a flat, rectangular container with a handle, used especially for carrying papers and documents.

words.ex: The managers met in the boardroom to discuss the plan.
words.ex_cn: 经理们在会议室里讨论计划。
words.en: A boardroom is a room where the board of directors of a company meets.

words.tr: phrase. 工伤事故；工业事故；劳动事故
words.ex: A worker died in an industrial accident last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周一名工人在工业事故中丧生。
words.en: An industrial accident is an unexpected event occurring in an industrial setting that causes injury or damage.

words.ex: The school offers vocational guidance to help students choose careers.
words.ex_cn: 学校提供职业指导，帮助学生选择职业。
words.en: Vocational guidance refers to the assistance given to individuals in choosing and preparing for a suitable occupation, based on their interests, abilities, and the needs of the society.

words.tr: phrase. 职业训练；职业培训
words.ex: He is doing vocational training to become a mechanic.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受职业培训，以成为一名机械师。
words.en: Vocational training refers to instructional programs or courses that focus on the skills required for a particular job function or trade.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.ex: He bought a paperback novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本平装小说。
words.en: A paperback is a book with a thin cardboard or paper cover, as opposed to a hardback, which has a hard cover.

words.ex: He has new-found confidence after passing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在通过考试后获得了新的信心。
words.en: New-found is used to describe something that has been recently discovered or acquired.

words.ex: He uses a spreadsheet to count his money.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子表格来计算他的钱。
words.en: A spreadsheet is a computer program that is used for displaying and dealing with numbers. It shows numbers in rows and columns, and it is used especially for doing financial calculations and for creating graphs.

words.tr: n. 编舞艺术；舞蹈编排；
words.ex: The dancer praised the choreography of the ballet.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者称赞了这部芭蕾舞的编舞艺术。
words.en: Choreography is the art of designing sequences of movements in which motion, form, or both are specified. Choreography may also refer to the design itself. A choreographer is one who creates choreographies by practicing the art of choreography.

words.ex: The factory lowered labour costs by using robots.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用机器人降低了劳动力成本。
words.en: The amount of money that a company spends on paying its workers.

words.ex: He is a permanent worker at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他是工厂的永久员工。
words.en: A permanent worker is an employee who has a long-term job contract with a company, as opposed to a temporary or contract worker.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The company hires skilled workers for the factory.
words.ex_cn: 公司为工厂招聘熟练工人。
words.en: A skilled worker is someone who has specialized training or experience in a particular field or occupation.

words.tr: phrase. 熟练工人，专业工人
words.ex: The factory needs a specialized worker for the machine.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要一名擅长操作这台机器的熟练工人。
words.en: A specialized worker is someone who has specific skills or knowledge in a particular area of work.

words.ex: He is a collaborator in the science project.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个科学项目的协助者。
words.en: A collaborator is someone who works jointly on an activity or project; an associate.

words.tr: n. 领班；工头；陪审团主席
words.ex: The foreman told the workers to start the job.
words.ex_cn: 工头告诉工人们开始工作。
words.en: A foreman is a skilled and experienced worker who is in charge of a group of workers, especially in a factory or on a building site.

words.ex: The craftsman made a wooden chair by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠手工制作了一把木椅。
words.en: A craftsman is a skilled worker who makes things by hand.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.ex: He works the night shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: A night shift is a period of work that occurs during the night, typically from late evening to early morning, in various industries and services.

words.ex: He used a template to write the report.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个模板来写报告。
words.en: A template is a thin sheet of plastic or metal in a particular shape, used in drawing shapes or cutting materials accurately.

words.ex: The old watermill turns slowly with the river flow.
words.ex_cn: 旧的水车随着河流缓慢转动。
words.en: A watermill is a mill that uses moving water as its power source; it is a structure that uses a water wheel or water turbine to drive a mechanical process such as milling (grinding), rolling, or hammering.

words.tr: n. 风车；风车房；玩具风车；
words.ex: The windmill turns slowly in the breeze.
words.ex_cn: 风车在微风中缓缓转动。
words.en: A windmill is a structure with long parts at the top that are turned around by the wind and produce power to crush grain or produce electricity.

words.ex: The wheel fell off because the axle broke.
words.ex_cn: 车轮掉了，因为车轴断了。
words.en: An axle is a rod or spindle (either fixed or rotating) passing through the center of a wheel or group of wheels.

words.ex: The centrifugal force pushes the water out of the clothes in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 离心力把水从衣服上甩出去。
words.en: A force that acts on a body moving in a circular path and is directed away from the center around which the body is moving.

words.tr:
n. 凿子
v. 雕；凿；欺骗
words.ex: He used a chisel to carve the stone.
words.ex_cn: 他用凿子雕刻石头。
words.en: A chisel is a tool with a long metal blade which has a sharp edge for cutting wood, stone, or metal.

words.ex: The floor was covered with sawdust after the carpenter worked.
words.ex_cn: 木匠工作后，地板上铺满了锯屑。
words.en: Sawdust consists of tiny particles of wood that are produced when you saw wood.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.ex: He nailed the wooden plank to the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把木板钉在了地板上。
words.en: A plank is a long, flat piece of wood, often used in building or as part of a structure.

words.ex: He carved a mortise to fit the tenon.
words.ex_cn: 他雕刻了一个卯眼来匹配榫头。
words.en: A mortise is a hole cut into a piece of wood or other material to receive a tenon, or a projection on the end of a piece of wood that fits into a mortise to form a joint.

words.ex: The carpenter carved a tenon to fit into the mortise.
words.ex_cn: 木匠雕刻了一个榫头，以插入卯眼。
words.en: A tenon is a projecting piece of wood made for insertion into a mortise in another piece.

words.ex: The warship sailed across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这艘军舰在海上航行。
words.en: A warship is a ship equipped with weapons and designed for combat at sea.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.ex: The ship took on ballast to stay stable in rough water.
words.ex_cn: 船为了在恶劣水域中保持稳定，装载了压舱物。
words.en: Ballast is heavy material that is carried in a ship or hot-air balloon to make it more stable.

words.ex: The captain turned the rudder to change the ship's direction.
words.ex_cn: 船长转动舵来改变船的方向。
words.en: A rudder is a flat piece of wood or metal at the back of a boat or aircraft that is used for steering.

words.ex: The sailors cleaned the stern of the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手们打扫了船尾。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behavior as stern, you mean that they are severe or strict.

words.ex: He grabbed the tiller to steer the boat.
words.ex_cn: 他抓住舵柄来操控船的方向。
words.en: A tiller is a handle used to turn the rudder of a boat from side to side, steering the boat. It can also refer to a person who tills land, a farmer, or a machine used in farming to prepare the soil for planting.

words.ex: The sailboat's mast is very tall.
words.ex_cn: 帆船的船桅很高。
words.en: A mast is a tall pole on a ship or boat that supports the sails.

words.tr: n. 索具；帆缆； v. “rig”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sailors checked the rigging before the sailboat set off.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在帆船启航前检查了索具。
words.en: The system of ropes, chains, and tackle used to support and control the masts, sails, and yards of a sailing vessel; the act of setting up or manipulating something, especially in a dishonest way.

words.ex: The hull of the boat was damaged by the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 船的船体被岩石损坏了。
words.en: The main body of a ship or other vessel, including the bottom, sides, and deck but not the masts, superstructure, rigging, engines, and other fittings.

words.ex: The boat docked at the quay.
words.ex_cn: 船停在了码头。
words.en: A quay is a long platform beside the sea or a river where boats can be tied up and loaded or unloaded.

words.ex: The building is built on solid bedrock.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑建在坚实的基岩上。
words.en: The solid rock underlying loose deposits such as soil or alluvium.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: The can is made of aluminium.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是铝制的。
words.en: A chemical element that is a light, silver-coloured metal, used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: Ancient people used flint to make fire.
words.ex_cn: 古人用燧石生火。
words.en: Flint is a very hard greyish-black stone that was used in former times for making tools and weapons, and for starting fires.

words.ex: A small flotilla sailed across the bay.
words.ex_cn: 一支小型船队驶过了海湾。
words.en: A flotilla is a group of small ships, especially military ships.

words.ex: He drives a red van to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的货车去上班。
words.en: A van is a road vehicle used for transporting goods or people, usually larger than a car but smaller than a truck.

words.ex: The company changed its tack after the market crash.
words.ex_cn: 公司在市场崩盘后改变了行动方针。
words.en: A tack is a short nail with a broad, flat head, used especially for fastening carpets. As a verb, it can mean to fasten something with tacks or to change the direction of a sailing ship.

words.ex: He gave her a handhold to climb the rock.
words.ex_cn: 他给了她一个抓手，让她爬岩石。
words.en: A handhold is something that provides support or help, especially in a difficult situation.

words.ex: The climbers found a foothold on the rocky wall.
words.ex_cn: 登山者在岩壁上找到了一个立足点。
words.en: A foothold is a secure position from which further progress or development may be made.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.tr:
n. 塑料；
adj. 塑料的；
words.ex: The bottle is made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是塑料做的。
words.en: A plastic is a material which is produced from oil by a chemical process and which is used to make many objects. It is light in weight and does not break easily.

words.ex: The farmer drives a tractor in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里开拖拉机。
words.en: A tractor is a powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment and trailers.

words.ex: The car hit a big pothole on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路上撞到了一个大坑。
words.en: A pothole is a large hole in the surface of a road, caused by traffic and bad weather.

words.tr:
n. 平板；厚板；厚片
v. 切成厚板
words.ex: He broke the slab of concrete with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子砸碎了那块混凝土板。
words.en: A slab is a thick, flat piece of a hard material such as stone, concrete, or wood.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: This lock is foolproof and easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁是万无一失的，而且容易使用。
words.en: A foolproof plan, system, or method is so well designed that it cannot go wrong or be used wrongly.

words.ex: He laboriously wrote the letter by hand.
words.ex_cn: 他费力地用手写这封信。
words.en: In a way that requires a lot of effort and time.

words.ex: He is ostensibly helping, but he is really slowing us down.
words.ex_cn: 他表面上在帮忙，但实际上是在拖后腿。
words.en: Used to indicate that something seems to be true or is officially stated to be true, but might not be.

words.tr: adj. 无产阶级的；n. 无产者
words.ex: The proletarian worked long hours in the factory.
words.ex_cn: 普罗在工厂里长时间工作。
words.en: A proletarian is a member of the proletariat, the class of wage-earners in a capitalist society whose only possession of significant material value is their labor-power.

words.ex: The trade union asked for higher wages.
words.ex_cn: 工会要求提高工资。
words.en: A trade union is an organization formed by workers to protect their rights and interests.

words.tr: n. 行会；同业公会；协会；
words.ex: The medieval guild controlled the price of bread.
words.ex_cn: 中世纪的行会控制了面包的价格。
words.en: A guild is an organization of people who do the same job or have the same interests.

words.ex: He joined a local book association.
words.ex_cn: 他加入了一个本地的图书协会。
words.en: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

words.ex: His emigration to Canada changed his life.
words.ex_cn: 他移民到加拿大改变了人生。
words.en: Emigration is the act of leaving one's own country to settle permanently in another; moving abroad.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.tr: phrase. 劳资联合委员会；劳资协议会
words.ex: The works council meets every month to talk about worker issues.
words.ex_cn: 员工委员会每月开会讨论员工问题。
words.en: A works council is an organization representing workers, which discusses with employers issues that affect employees, such as working conditions, safety, and wages.

words.ex: The company follows labour law to protect workers.
words.ex_cn: 公司遵守劳动法以保护工人。
words.en: Labour law is the body of laws, administrative rulings, and precedents which address the legal rights of, and restrictions on, working people and their organizations.

words.ex: The doctor performed resuscitation after the heart stopped.
words.ex_cn: 心脏停止后，医生进行了复苏。
words.en: The act of reviving someone from unconsciousness or apparent death.

words.ex: The outlay for the new computer was high.
words.ex_cn: 这台新电脑的花费很高。
words.en: An outlay is an amount of money that you have to spend in order to buy something or to start a project.

words.ex: He received fair remuneration for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他因工作获得了公平的报酬。
words.en: Remuneration refers to the money that is paid to someone for the work that they have done.

words.ex: The wage index rises every year.
words.ex_cn: 工资指数每年都在上涨。
words.en: A wage index is a statistical measure used to track changes in wages over time, often used to adjust salaries or to compare wage levels across different regions or industries.

words.tr: phrase. 基础工资；基本工资
words.ex: He earns a basic wage of $10 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 他每小时赚10美元的基本工资。
words.en: The basic wage is the minimum amount of money that an employer agrees to pay an employee for a specified period of work.

words.tr: phrase. 全部收入；工资总额
words.ex: His gross wages are $3000 per month.
words.ex_cn: 他的税前工资是每月3000美元。
words.en: The total amount of wages paid by an employer to employees before any deductions such as taxes.

words.tr: n. 小时工资；按小时计酬的工资
words.ex: He earns hourly wages of $15 at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在杂货店每小时赚15美元的工资。
words.en: Payment for work calculated on an hourly basis, rather than a salary or piece rate.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.ex: Free lunch is a perk of this job.
words.ex_cn: 免费午餐是这份工作的一个额外补贴。
words.en: If someone perks up or if something perks them up, they become more cheerful or lively.

words.ex: He gets his money on payday.
words.ex_cn: 他在发薪日拿到工资。
words.en: The day on which someone receives their wages or salary.

words.ex: He checked his pay slip on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他在周五查看了工资单。
words.en: A pay slip is a document given to an employee each time they are paid, detailing the amount of money earned and any deductions.

words.ex: The company updated the payroll last Friday.
words.ex_cn: 公司上星期五更新了职工工资册。
words.en: A payroll is a list of employees and the amount of money they are to be paid, or the total amount of money paid to the employees of a company.

words.tr: phrase. 失业救济金；失业津贴
words.ex: He receives unemployment benefit while looking for a job.
words.ex_cn: 他在找工作期间领取失业救济金。
words.en: A payment made by the state or, in some countries, by a trade union, to an unemployed person.

words.ex: He receives an old-age pension every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月领取老年养老金。
words.en: A regular payment made by the state to people of or above the official retirement age and to some widows and disabled people.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.ex: The rain gave us a short respite from the heat.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨为我们带来了短暂的凉爽缓解。
words.en: A respite is a short period of rest or relief from something difficult or unpleasant.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.tr: adj. 多年生的；反复出现的；
words.ex: These perennial flowers bloom every year.
words.ex_cn: 这些多年生的花每年都会开花。
words.en: A perennial plant is one that lives for more than two years, often flowering and producing seeds multiple times over its lifespan.

words.ex: The issue polarised the voters.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题使选民意见两极分化。
words.en: To polarise means to cause people to divide into two opposing groups or to cause something to have two opposite or contradictory tendencies, qualities, or aspects.

words.tr: v. 预先占有；抢先行动；阻止某人做某事（通常指在别人之前采取行动以获得优势）
words.ex: He pre-empted the meeting by arriving early.
words.ex_cn: 他提前到达以抢占会议时间。
words.en: To act in advance to prevent something from happening.

words.ex: Can you pronounce this word correctly?
words.ex_cn: 你能正确发音这个词吗？
words.en: To pronounce means to make the sound of a word or letter with your voice. It can also mean to declare or announce something officially or formally.

words.ex: They will remodel their kitchen next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月要重新装修厨房。
words.en: To remodel something means to change its structure or form, often to improve it.

words.ex: The roof has a sharp slant.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶有一个陡峭的倾斜。
words.en: If something slants or if you slant it, it is at an angle rather than being straight up and down or straight from side to side.

words.tr:
n. 违背；
v. 攻破；
words.ex: The company committed a breach of contract.
words.ex_cn: 该公司违反了合同。
words.en: A breach of a law, rule, or agreement is an act of breaking it.

words.tr: n. 特技表演；噱头；发育不良的动植物；
words.ex: The actor performed a dangerous stunt in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员在电影中表演了一个危险的特技。
words.en: A stunt is a dangerous feat that is done to entertain people, especially in a film.

words.ex: He will sue the company for damages.
words.ex_cn: 他将起诉这家公司要求赔偿。
words.en: To sue means to start a legal case against someone, usually to claim money from them because they have caused you harm or loss.

words.tr:
n. 怠工
adj. 怠工的
words.ex: The workers are on a go-slow to protest low pay.
words.ex_cn: 工人们进行慢工抗议低工资。
words.en: A go-slow is a form of protest in which workers deliberately work slowly in order to cause problems for their employers.

words.tr: phrase. (工会给予工人的）罢工津贴
words.ex: The workers received strike pay while they were on strike.
words.ex_cn: 工人们罢工期间收到了罢工津贴。
words.en: Strike pay refers to financial support provided to workers by their union during a strike, to help compensate for the wages lost due to the work stoppage.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.tr:
n. 批准；允许；认可；制裁；处罚
v. 批准；认可；制裁；处罚
words.ex: The company got official sanction to open a new branch.
words.ex_cn: 该公司获得了开设新分公司的正式批准。
words.en: A sanction is a penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or an official permission or approval for an action.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.ex: His dismissal made him very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的被解雇让他非常难过。
words.en: The act of officially removing someone from their job, or the act of sending someone away or allowing them to leave.

words.ex: The two sides started negotiation to solve the conflict.
words.ex_cn: 双方开始了谈判以解决冲突。
words.en: Negotiation is a discussion aimed at reaching an agreement.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.tr: n. 寄宿处； v. “lodge”的现在分词；
words.ex: He found cheap lodging near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 他在火车站附近找到了便宜的寄宿处。
words.en: Lodging refers to a place to live or stay, especially temporarily.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.ex: He lives in a small hamlet near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小村庄里。
words.en: A hamlet is a small settlement, generally one smaller than a village, and strictly (in Britain) one without a church.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: They pulled up stakes and moved to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们收拾行囊搬到了城市。
words.en: If someone pulls up stakes, they leave the place where they have been living or working, usually to go and live or work somewhere else.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: The prince is the heir to the throne.
words.ex_cn: 王子是王位的继承人。
words.en: A person legally entitled to inherit property or a title.

words.ex: My dormmate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A person with whom one shares a dormitory room.

words.ex: The warden checks the prison every morning.
words.ex_cn: 狱长每天早上检查监狱。
words.en: A warden is a person who is responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing, or for ensuring that laws or rules are obeyed.

words.ex: They live in a small bungalow near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一座小平房里。
words.en: A bungalow is a small house, usually having one story.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: He lives in the dorm with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dorm is a large building at a college or university where students live.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.ex: The house has three storeys.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子有三层。
words.en: A storey is a level of a building; a floor.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在大厅里集合。
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.tr: n. 自动扶梯；电动扶梯；
words.ex: He took the escalator to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘自动扶梯上了二楼。
words.en: An escalator is a moving staircase that carries people between floors of a building or structure.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: Click the tab to open the new page.
words.ex_cn: 点击标签以打开新页面。
words.en: A tab is a small piece of material that sticks out from something, used for opening, closing, or identifying it. In computing, a tab is a key on a keyboard that moves the cursor a set number of spaces or to a specific position. In a restaurant or bar, a tab is a bill for food or drinks that is kept and paid for later.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: The bulb broke when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡掉到地上时碎了。
words.en: A bulb is the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it. It can also refer to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, consisting of a short stem surrounded by fleshy scale leaves or leaf bases, lying dormant over winter.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor with a broom.
words.ex_cn: 她用扫帚扫地。
words.en: A broom is a cleaning tool consisting of usually stiff fibers attached to, and roughly parallel to, a cylindrical handle, the broomstick. It is thus a variety of brush with a long handle.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: The king kept gold in his coffer.
words.ex_cn: 国王把黄金存放在他的金库中。
words.en: A coffer is a large strong chest used for storing valuable objects such as money or gold.

words.ex: He works in real estate in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事房地产行业。
words.en: Real estate refers to property consisting of land or buildings.

words.ex: He walked up the staircase to his room.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去了他的房间。
words.en: A staircase is a set of stairs inside a building, often including the supporting structure, the handrails, and sometimes the landings at the top and bottom.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.ex: He keeps his valuables in a safe box.
words.ex_cn: 他把贵重物品放在保险箱里。
words.en: Items that are worth a lot of money and are therefore important to keep safe.

words.ex: She wore a white pearl necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条白色的珍珠项链。
words.en: A pearl is a hard, rounded object formed within the shell of a pearl oyster or similar mollusk, highly prized as a gemstone.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.ex: He paid off his debt last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月还清了债务。
words.en: A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

words.tr: n. 先令（英国1971年以前的辅币，等于12便士）
words.ex: He paid five shillings for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五个先令买面包。
words.en: A shilling was a coin used in Britain before the decimalization of the currency in 1971, worth one twentieth of a pound or twelve pence.

words.ex: The old coin was worth one guinea.
words.ex_cn: 这枚旧硬币价值一几尼。
words.en: A guinea is an old British coin, worth one pound and one shilling, or the amount of that coin.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: He wrote his postcode on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮编写在了信封上。
words.en: A postcode is a sequence of letters and numbers which is part of an address and shows exactly where a place is.

words.ex: He packed his luggage before the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他在旅行前收拾好了行李。
words.en: Luggage consists of the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel.
